aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.title: Sponsored compute acceptance price now configurable via env
aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.summary: sponsored-compute-contract.ts now reads FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_COMPUTE_ACCEPTANCE_PRICE_CENTS. Absent values default to 200 cents, preserving the existing paid contract. Malformed or unsafe-integer prices return null, causing readSponsoredComputePolicy to close admission. The hardcoded $2 acceptance fee is replaced by the parsed integer.

a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.title: Add Gravity Showcase experiment telemetry and validation
a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.summary: New `gravity-showcase-experiment.ts` defines `GravityShowcaseExperiment` types and `gravityShowcaseAssignment` logic using FNV-1a hashing for stable user bucketing into 'treatment' or 'control' arms. `axiom-only-log.ts` adds `createGravityShowcasePresentationTelemetry` to strictly validate client reports against a closed enum of variants and regex patterns for IDs, returning `null` on failure to prevent raw payload retention. `log-ingest.ts` integrates this validation into `buildLogRows`, ensuring `ADS_SHOWCASE_PRESENTED_EVENT` records are only ingested when they pass full schema checks and have a valid `userId`. The `AnalyticsEvent` enum includes the new `ADS_SHOWCASE_PRESENTED` constant.

af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.title: Allow one-time hosted to BYOK migration in run.ts
af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.summary: The inference source check in sdk/src/run.ts now permits a single transition from hosted 'codebuff' to 'byok'. This prevents valid BYOK migrations from triggering credential mismatch errors on resumed runs. The change ensures BYOK pins remain immutable while allowing initial hosted history to move to personal providers.

871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.title: 0.0.173 release
871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.summary: CLI release version bumped to 0.0.173 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. Standard packaging update.

c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.title: Add updateRequired flag and model messages
c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.summary: Added `updateRequired` boolean to `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse` and two helper functions in `freebuff-models.ts` to generate user-facing text. The flag distinguishes client version incompatibility from model unavailability on the Desktop multi-session path, preventing incorrect double-charges. `freebuffUpdateRequiredModelMessage` and `freebuffUpdateRequiredAvailabilityLabel` provide precise wording for both modern and legacy clients, ensuring the model isn't blamed for build limitations.

bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.title: Desktop idle timeout raised to 15 minutes
bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.summary: FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_IDLE_RELEASE_MS increased from 10 to 15 minutes in common/src/constants/freebuff-desktop-sessions.ts. Desktop now ends hosted sessions and frees slots after 15 minutes idle. New constants FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_ADMITTED_AT_HEADER and FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_ATTEMPT_HEADER added for tab pinning and POST identity.

2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.title: Desktop Showcase and Spotlight ad copy updated
2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.summary: Ad copy for Desktop Spotlight and Showcase placements in `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts` replaced with three new variants: 'Keep building', 'Code anywhere', and 'Pick your model'. New WebP asset `assets/ads/freebuff-pro-after-hours.webp` and description added. The change aligns Showcase (banner above composer) and Spotlight (post-task interrupt) with active campaign wording, removing accent markup from Showcase titles to prevent rendering issues.

2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.title: Rename spend label to model spend
2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.summary: FREEBUFF_SPEND_UNIT_LABEL updated from 'tokens' to 'model spend' in common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts to resolve ambiguity between token counts and dollar ceilings. Added optional modelSpendUsd field to FreebuffRecentUsage in common/src/types/freebuff-usage.ts, representing estimated list-price USD costs. The new field is omitted when FREEBUFF_MODEL_SPEND_AUDIENCE restricts visibility, requiring clients to handle absence without local logic. Scope limited to Shared/Core constants and types.

6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.title: Add purchasesPaused flag and model-specific availability messages
6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.summary: Added `purchasesPaused` boolean to `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse` in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` to signal server-side pause of new purchased Desktop sessions without indicating model failure. Introduced `freebuffPurchasesPausedModelMessage` and `freebuffPurchasesPausedAvailabilityLabel` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to provide precise user-facing text that scopes unavailability to purchased sessions only. Backward compatible: older clients ignore the flag and use the updated `availableHours` wording which avoids blaming the model. This prevents users from switching away from valid models during temporary admission pauses.

f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.title: Thinker agent switches to GPT-5.6 Luna with xhigh reasoning
f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.summary: The `thinker-gemini` agent definition now uses `FREEBUFF_GPT_5_6_LUNA_MODEL_ID` with `reasoningOptions.effort` set to `xhigh`, replacing the previous `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` configuration. This change expands the `AgentDefinition` and `OpenRouterReasoningOptions` types in `common/src/types` to accept `max` and `xhigh` effort levels. The update aligns the chat deliberation agent with higher reasoning capabilities while maintaining the existing `thinker-gemini` ID to preserve registration and prompt spawning compatibility.

4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.title: Fix Linux sandbox git lock and clarify CLI proposal error codes
4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.summary: Sponsored CLI runs now map machine-readable error codes (like `funded_accept_required`) to human-readable sentences instead of displaying raw codes. The Linux sandbox implementation for linked worktrees was rewritten to use an empty tmpfs with read-only rebinds for the real `.git` common dir, allowing `packed-refs.lock` creation while preventing `packed-refs` modification. `OverrideToolHandlers` type was corrected to separate `read_files` signature, removing `as never` casts in `sponsored-run.ts`.

b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.title: Add purchase continuity header and refund types
b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.summary: Introduces `FREEBUFF_PURCHASE_CONTINUITY_HEADER` (`x-freebuff-purchase-continuity`) to enforce single-use execution claims for Desktop instances. Adds `FreebuffDesktopRefundInfo` and `FreebuffDesktopPurchaseInfo` types, exposing `desktopPurchases` and `desktopRefunds` in admission responses for picker metadata. CLI `use-freebuff-session` hook now handles `purchase_claim_released`, `purchase_in_use`, and `purchase_capacity` states by halting retries. Refund data links to original debit accounting instant and restored daily pool via `poolDate`.

81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.title: Ignore GitHub OIDC credential files
81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.summary: Added pattern to ignore short-lived GitHub OIDC credential files. Prevents accidental commits of sensitive runner credentials. Scope limited to repository configuration.

54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.title: Bump freebuff CLI to 0.0.172
54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.summary: Version bumped to 0.0.172 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No code changes.

a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.title: Remove unused agent visibility utils from message-tree-utils
a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.summary: Deleted `getDescendantIds`, `getAncestorIds`, and `isAgentVisible` from `cli/src/utils/message-tree-utils.ts`. These helper functions for traversing agent message trees and checking visibility against collapsed states were removed. The `buildMessageTree` function remains intact.

e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.title: imprezia-client.ts adds clientIp param
e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.summary: imprezia-client.ts accepts optional clientIp in postToImprezia, fetchImpreziaChatAd, and fetchImpreziaDisplayAd. Sets X-Forwarded-For header from single end-user IP via proxy-aware resolver. Scope limited to common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts. Raw XFF chains explicitly rejected in favor of resolved IP.

cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.title: Sponsored procedure runtime inputs
cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.summary: Added sponsored procedure runtime inputs to pass advertiser links without altering consented procedure text. New files `sponsored-procedure-inputs.ts`, `sponsored-proposal-cta.ts`, `sponsored-run-outcomes.ts` define the mechanism. Procedure hash stays immutable (COD-512); `{{advertiserLink}}` placeholder triggers separate non-hashed prompt section. CLI `buildSponsoredPrompt` and `SponsoredRun.execute` updated to inject sanitized URLs. Covers `common/src/ads` and `cli/src/utils`.

abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.title: Fix accidental model selection during Freebucks intro
abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.summary: Refactored Freebucks intro state into `useFreebucksIntro` hook and added `keyboardSuspended` prop to `FreebuffModelSelector`. Prevents the intro card's 'press any key' dismissal from also committing the focused model row and charging a session. The landing screen now suspends the picker's keyboard while the intro card is visible. Also introduced `isPricedOut` logic to ensure unaffordable rows display paywall messages instead of remaining inert.

df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.title: Solar Pro 4 endpoint switched to non-ZDR for debugging
df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.summary: SOLAR_PRO_4_OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT changed from 'upstage/zdr' to 'upstage' in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. This switch supports Upstage's requested non-ZDR route for provider-side debugging, requiring `allow_fallbacks: false` in applyOpenRouterProviderRouting to prevent traffic splitting. The dataUse comment clarifies this is not a ZDR promise, keeping internal training traces disabled despite the endpoint change.

3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.title: Replace hard daily spend limits with soft session pacing
3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.summary: Freebuff removed per-account daily spend ceilings and monthly subscription caps, replacing them with soft per-session pacing targets in `FREEBUFF_PER_MODEL_SESSION_SPEND_CAPS`. Crossing a target now triggers a pause instead of a hard refusal, while legacy `turn_spend_limit` errors are retained only for compatibility with older servers. The CLI header no longer displays remaining monthly usage, and session API 409 responses now safely clone the body to prevent stream consumption errors. This shift moves enforcement from static budget blocks to dynamic session pacing across Web, CLI, and Desktop.

5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.title: Add Solar Pro 4 zero-price transition
5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.summary: Added a price transition to `SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES` setting `FREEBUFF_SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL_ID` to 0 Freebucks at `2026-09-09T15:49:00Z`. This ensures idle clients update pricing correctly via server quotes, preserving historical accounting data. The change affects the shared core constants in `common/src/constants/freebuff-solar-promo.ts`.

385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.title: Freebuff CLI adds wallet spend limit consent flow
385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.summary: CLI session start now requires explicit wallet spend limits for metered models. New `consent_required` status and `FREEBUFF_WALLET_SPEND_LIMIT_HEADER` gate session admission. Shared `freebuff-model-selection.ts` unifies picker logic across surfaces. `freebucksOf` returns `null` for unavailable balances, distinguishing from `undefined` (unmetered).

f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.title: Add ads.mcptoolcall Axiom log event
f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.summary: New `ADS_MCP_TOOL_CALL_EVENT` ('ads.mcp_tool_call') added to `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. Defines `ADS_MCP_TOOL_CALL_FIELDS` schema (`advertiser_id`, `key_id`, `tool`, `outcome`, `error_code`, `duration_ms`) and registers event in `AxiomOnlyLogEvent` union plus `getAxiomOnlyLogEvent` handler. Uses `sanitizeAllowlistedFields` to enforce content-free logging of MCP operations.

f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.title: Freebucks ceiling notice update
f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.summary: The `FREEBUFF_FREEBUCKS_CEILING_NOTICE` string in `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts` updated to reflect a four-times Freebucks value cap, replacing the previous three-times limit. This ensures user-facing copy matches the current backend enforcement logic for runaway usage protection. Scope limited to core constants.

6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.title: Move Earn constants to freebuff-earn.ts after Trust retirement
6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.summary: New file `common/src/constants/freebuff-earn.ts` isolates Earn page prompts and path, previously in `freebuff-levels.ts`. Trust and Levels ladder retired 2026-09-07; page persists, so constants decoupled from deprecated currency. CLI `freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` updates import path. Prompts now reference `Freebucks` engagement, not `Trust` sessions; `FREEBUFF_EARN_PATH` remains `/earn/trust` for legacy link compatibility.

7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.title: Add truncated response body to Imprezia error logs
7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.summary: postToImprezia now reads and logs the response text (capped at 300 chars) alongside the HTTP status on API errors. Previous logs only recorded the status code (e.g., 400), making the root cause of frequent Imprezia failures unknowable. The body is read defensively with a catch to prevent log errors from failing the ad fetch, and truncated to limit third-party string length in our logs. This change applies to common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts.

17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.title: /end-session refunds 90% unspent cost
17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.summary: The /end-session command now returns 90% of unspent session cost to the user's wallet, rounded down. This change introduces a `releaseSlot` method in `freebuff-session-store.ts` to handle the DELETE request and refund logic, replacing the previous `releaseFreebuffSlot` utility. The CLI landing screen (`freebuff-landing-screen.tsx`) displays refund status messages like 'Your refund is awaiting final usage' or 'X Freebucks returned to your wallet'. Refund processing is coalesced across exit, unmount, and explicit end commands to prevent duplicate actions on the same authenticated instance.

95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.title: Premium session limit restored to 5
95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.summary: FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT increased from 4 to 5 in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. FREEBUFF_PRE_LEVELS_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT and FREEBUFF_PRE_LEVELS_LIMITED_SESSION_LIMIT removed, eliminating the Levels-specific rollback lever. Level 0 and Level 1 premiumSessionsPerDay updated from 4 to 5 in common/src/constants/freebuff-levels.ts.

e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.title: Remove GPT-5.6 Luna from global Pro catalog
e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna is removed from `FREEBUFF_PRO_ONLY_CATALOG_MODEL_IDS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. This decouples the global paid boundary from the limited-tier plan-only set, allowing full-access users to spend their shared premium allowance on Luna while keeping it plan-locked for limited regions. `FREEBUFF_PRO_ONLY_CATALOG_MODEL_IDS` now contains only Gemini 3.8 Flash. The scope is limited to Freebuff Web, where the Pro gate is enforced via `FREEBUFF_PRO_ENFORCED_SURFACES`; CLI and Desktop remain unaffected.

04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.title: CLI peak pricing badge and tooltip in local time
04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.summary: Adds a dedicated peak pricing detail chip to the CLI model selector, replacing the generic server prose notice for affected models. The `freebucks.peak` object now drives a local-timezone tooltip via `freebucksPeakCopy`, explaining the surcharge and base price return time. This change spans `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` and new utility logic in `common/src/util/freebuff-peak-price.ts`. The implementation duplicates the 'Freebucks' label constant to bypass export leak checks associated with private price tables.

8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.title: Turn spend limit message rewritten
8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.summary: The `FREEBUFF_TURN_SPEND_LIMIT_MESSAGE` constant in `common/src/constants/freebuff-errors.ts` was shortened from a verbose diagnostic hinting at agent loops to a direct statement that the turn reached its model usage limit. The accompanying JSDoc comment removed the claim that the error is not a quota, clarifying that the 429 `turn_spend_limit` response is strictly non-transient and blocks retries on the same turn. This change affects the shared error constants used by the completions API spend breaker and all client surfaces that display this message.

5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.title: GLM 5.3 Flash becomes limited tier hero
5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.summary: Split `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` into coercion target (DeepSeek V4 Flash) and new `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_HERO_MODEL_ID` (GLM 5.3 Flash). GLM leads limited pickers because it is cheapest (~5x under DeepSeek) and priced at 5 Freebucks on all tiers. DeepSeek remains coercion target to ensure joinability without meter or grant. Covers `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and README.

ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.title: CLI package version bumped to 0.0.171
ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json incremented from 0.0.170 to 0.0.171. Standard release prep for the CLI binary. Scope limited to the release manifest.

52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.title: gitignore updates for local env and editor settings
52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.summary: Added `!.env.local.example` to `.gitignore` to allow tracking of local environment examples while ignoring `.env.local`. Included `xcuserdata/` and `.claude/settings.local.json` to exclude Xcode user data and local Claude settings. Changes affect repository hygiene only.

54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.title: CLI freebucks header adds daily reset countdown
54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.summary: CLI freebucks header adds daily reset countdown. New `freebucksResetCountdown` helper formats time remaining until pool refill. `freebucksHeaderLine` accepts optional `nowMs` to trigger countdown display. Aligns CLI metered account header with Web and Desktop pickers.

d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.title: freebuff 0.0.169
d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.summary: Version bump to 0.0.169. No functional changes.

253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.title: freebuff-free-promotions.ts derives spend windows from price schedule
253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.summary: New file `common/src/constants/freebuff-free-promotions.ts` defines `FREEBUFF_FREE_PROMOTION_SPEND_WINDOWS` and `isFreePromotionSpendAt`, deriving free-spend windows directly from `SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES` in `freebuff-solar-promo.ts`. This prevents drift between the user-facing free offer and the allowance exemption, ensuring provider cost for free models does not consume the user's daily dollar budget. The logic merges overlapping free transitions into single spans and uses `2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z` for open-ended windows to avoid null branches in SQL comparisons.

872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.title: Add country exclusion codes to advertiser reason redaction
872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.summary: Two new reason codes, `country_excluded` and `country_unresolved`, are added to the operator, safe, and visible maps in `advertiser-reason-redaction.ts`. These codes are visible to advertisers because the rule originates from their own configuration, and they remain distinct to differentiate between a targeted exclusion and a placement failure. The `ADVERTISER_REASON_REDACTION_VERSION` constant increments to `advertiser_reason_redaction_2026_09_v2`.

02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.title: Add Freebuff Pro hero assets and break ad placements
02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.summary: Introduced `assets/ads/freebuff-pro-hero.svg` and `freebuff-pro-hero-1600x1000.png` to serve as the visual hero for Freebuff Pro sponsor breaks. Updated `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts` to define `HOUSE_BREAK_AD_VARIATIONS` keyed by placement IDs (`Desktop-Spotlight`, `Desktop-Showcase`) rather than surfaces, ensuring these creatives are excluded from the text-only floor used in `HOUSE_AD_CREATIVES`. The new assets enforce strict budget limits (28/60/18 chars) and omit `imageUrl` fields, as break heroes rely on uploaded bytes via `hero_image_public_token` instead of static paths. A test suite asserts that the SVG content remains synchronized with `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS` pricing data to prevent stale visual claims.

a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.title: Ad accent span parser, placement format labels, CLI 0.0.170
a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.summary: New `common/src/ads/accent-span.ts` parses `*...*` headline accents via `splitAccentSpan` and `stripAccentSpan`, returning plain text for non-accent surfaces. `freebuff-placements.ts` adds `SPONSOR_BREAK_FREQUENCY_COPY` and `PLACEMENT_FORMAT_LABELS` to enforce consistent naming for `Desktop-Spotlight`, `Desktop-Showcase`, `Desktop-Intermission`, and `Single-Ad-Unit-1`. CLI package version bumps to 0.0.170.

4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.title: Skip elevatedcountry and trustlevel ceilings when on Freebucks meter
4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.summary: resolveFreebuffSpendCeiling in freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts now bypasses elevated_country and trust_level cohorts when onFreebucksMeter is true. These cohorts were sized for the session era and sit below the plan ceiling, causing accounts with Freebucks to be falsely told they had "used all of today's free usage" (57 accounts on 2026-09-05). Abuse cohorts (restricted country, anonymising egress, flagged domain, third-party client) still compose by minimum. The guard adds !onFreebucksMeter to both the elevatedCountries and trustLevelCeilingUsd checks.

c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.title: CLI spendlimited refusal carry freebucks block
c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.summary: CLI `use-freebuff-session.ts` now carries the `freebucks` block from the current session state into `rate_limited` and `spend_limited` responses if the server omits it. This prevents the landing screen from rendering dollar-cent values as session counts during monthly allowance walls. The `freebuff-session.ts` type definitions explicitly mark this field as client-carried, never server-sent. `freebuff-landing-screen.tsx` updates copy to distinguish metered daily caps from Freebuff limits and formats long retry durations in days.

bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash removed from free model picker
bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash was withdrawn from the free model picker on 2026-09-03, hours after release, due to reliability and speed issues. Despite a routing fix, the endpoint failed on 25% of probes, making the most expensive row unstable for full-access users. The model ID remains in SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS for backward compatibility with installed binaries, but is added to FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS to prevent new sessions. Updates applied to README.md, README.zh-CN.md, freebuff-models.ts, and CLI release docs.

d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.title: Muse Spark 1.3 added to CLI and Desktop free model picker
d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 expanded from Web/Cloud-only to all surfaces (CLI, Desktop, Web, Cloud) via new agent definitions and constant updates. This change addresses prior rate-limiting constraints by leveraging a shared key pool (600 RPM vs 150) and automatic fallback to DeepSeek V4 Flash when saturated. Scope covers `agents/base2`, `agents/base3-free`, `agents/reviewer`, `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`, `freebuff-desktop-sessions.ts`, `freebuff-models.ts`, and documentation files. A new `code-reviewer-muse-spark-1-3` agent is registered to prevent 403 errors during base2 rollbacks, though it remains unspawned today because both primary roots set `noReview`.

9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.title: Solar Pro 4 added to free model picker
9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.summary: Solar Pro 4 (`upstage/solar-pro4`) is added to the free model picker as a limited-time trial, serving via OpenRouter with zero data retention. The model is registered across base2, base3, and code-reviewer agents in `agents/` and mapped in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. Context window is capped at 500k (conservative estimate vs published 524k) in `freebuff-models.ts` to prevent hard failures. Pricing is $0.30/M in, $1.20/M out (billed via BYOK upstream costs), making it more expensive than Luna.

92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.title: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in free model catalog
92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.summary: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in the free model picker after 1.3 began returning upstream 404 model_not_found errors. Saved 1.2 preferences migrate to 1.3 on load; existing live sessions keep running. Covers Web, CLI, and Desktop via FREEBUFF_MODELS plus README tables; 1.2 keeps its fast all-round row.

0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces dated 07/31 model in free picker
0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 renamed to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in the free model catalog to reflect upstream wire ID updates, replacing the build-date suffix with a vendor-aligned version. The `multimodal` flag is set to true, verified against the live API, and the CLI selector now renders server-provided `freebucks.upgrade` offers on surcharged rows instead of deriving tier logic locally. Changes span `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, and README documentation.

68b487b1f0fc0e9fd42f83503efa2533890ff411.title: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro in model catalog
68b487b1f0fc0e9fd42f83503efa2533890ff411.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro as the deep-reasoning model. OpenRouter routing uses default slug handling with price ceilings to avoid expensive endpoints. Affects CLI, Web, Desktop agents via `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and `free-agents.ts`. New cap: 2 sessions/day for GLM 5.3 Flash, unlike DeepSeek V4 Pro's unlimited access.

4ac1fd1d59197d7f28602ac38da5d4c46e0277a3.title: Add Gemini 3.8 Flash to model catalog
4ac1fd1d59197d7f28602ac38da5d4c46e0277a3.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash added to free model picker via new `base3` and `base2` agent definitions and `FREEBUFF_GEMINI_38_FLASH_MODEL_ID`. Requires dedicated reviewer agent to prevent base2 fallback to disallowed DeepSeek Flash reviewer. Covers Web, CLI, Desktop via shared root IDs in `free-agents.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts`. Model routes to OpenRouter flex tier using specific upstream ordering and price ceiling to avoid 2x cost/7x latency Vertex default.

8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.title: Ox Alpha withdrawn from free model picker
8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.summary: Ox Alpha removed from FREEBUFF_MODELS and picker lists after host ended free promotion 2026-08-27. Model id paused in FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS rather than deleted, keeping root agent base2-free-ox-alpha and its pinned model allowlist to let live sessions drain without mid-run 403s or free_mode_invalid_agent_model wedges. Covers README.md, README.zh-CN.md, freebuff/cli/release/README.md, and common/src/constants/free-agents.ts plus freebuff-models.ts. MiMo 2.5 is sole unmetered row; Ox Alpha row kept in catalog but absent from FREEBUFF_WEB_ALL_MODELS and derived standard lists.

26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.title: Muse Spark 1.3 replaces 1.2 in free model picker
26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 restores its position in the free model picker, replacing Muse Spark 1.2 across Web, CLI, and Desktop surfaces. This follows 1.3's upstream restoration on 2026-09-13 after a brief withdrawal caused by `404 model_not_found` errors. Muse Spark 1.2 is retired from the active list via `FREEBUFF_WEB_RETIRED_PICKER_MODEL_IDS` but remains in `SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS` to serve existing live sessions and installed builds. Saved 1.2 preferences now migrate to 1.3 on load via `supersededBy` configuration.

654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.title: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in free model catalog
654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.summary: Muse Spark 1.2 restored as active picker row, replacing 1.3. 1.3's `supersededBy` migration block removed from `freebuff-models.ts`; 1.2 now serves all surfaces directly. Scope covers `README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md`, `free-agents.ts`, and CLI release docs. Key detail: 1.2 stays last in list due to shared rate-limit queue fallback to DeepSeek V4 Flash.

77a74b9437db605159cf13c57b72d52293a6f17b.title: CLI release 1.0.686
77a74b9437db605159cf13c57b72d52293a6f17b.summary: Version bump to 1.0.686. Updates package.json for both codebuff and freebuff CLI releases. No functional changes.

c8464c6866193ec4780e23b225ab06252eee2ffc.title: CLI release 1.0.684 adds legacy Gemini model ID
c8464c6866193ec4780e23b225ab06252eee2ffc.summary: Version 1.0.684 published for codebuff CLI, Freebuff CLI 0.0.121. Added LEGACY_GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_LITE_PREVIEW_MODEL_ID constant in common/src/constants/gemini.ts. Covers shared core constants and CLI release packages. New constant identifies retired model ID emitted by clients released before July 2026.

cbdf5030d0238565dfe2852e8eacc93bfc803b82.title: MiniMax M3 withdrawn from free model picker
cbdf5030d0238565dfe2852e8eacc93bfc803b82.summary: MiniMax M3 removed from free model picker due to excessive cost. Withdrawal enforced at session admission via model_unavailable gate code. Existing sessions drain normally to prevent client wedge. Files: freebuff-models.ts, free-agents.ts, freebuff-session.ts.

ed26dd9b5f6f9727085a011414d3e8ceb738118f.title: CLI 1.0.685
ed26dd9b5f6f9727085a011414d3e8ceb738118f.summary: CLI release 1.0.685 published. Version bump in `cli/release/package.json`. Covers CLI surface.

c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro replaces V4 Pro 08/13 in free model picker
c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 in the free model picker. The change aligns the catalog with server-side model substitutions and prevents fallback routing to paused models, which would cause refusals during queue overflow. Updates span `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, CLI landing screens, and README tables. `cloudPlannerAgentIdForModel` now returns the primary agent ID for both variants since they share the same model, avoiding misrouting to limited roots.

bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.title: CLI 1.0.681 published
bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.summary: Version bump to 1.0.681 in `cli/release/package.json`. Covers CLI release artifacts. No functional changes in this patch.

78d1eebe0a27ffa9f8d4d3b6d38261f19d5acd11.title: CLI release 1.0.687
78d1eebe0a27ffa9f8d4d3b6d38261f19d5acd11.summary: Version bumped to 1.0.687 in cli/release/package.json. Routine release.

f8ed82aaaa4ed3c5776a04b6c7423b894b294f74.title: Ox Alpha added to free model picker
f8ed82aaaa4ed3c5776a04b6c7423b894b294f74.summary: Ox Alpha joins the free model catalog on CLI and Desktop, backed by new `base3-free-ox-alpha` and `code-reviewer-ox-alpha` agent definitions. This ensures Ox Alpha sessions use their own reviewer agent instead of falling back to the DeepSeek Flash reviewer, which would be rejected by the session allowlist. The change spans `agents/`, `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, `common/src/constants/`, and README docs. Ox Alpha is marked experimental with a 1M context window and no session cost, appearing alongside MiMo 2.5 in the limited access tier.

358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.title: codebuff CLI 1.0.688 release
358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.summary: Version bump to 1.0.688 in cli/release/package.json. Routine release artifact update.

9d2ffeb174143be273cd3257275edcf79094c33f.title: Add DeepSeek V4, GPT-5.6 Luna, MiniMax M3, MiMo 2.5 to free model
9d2ffeb174143be273cd3257275edcf79094c33f.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT-5.6 Luna, MiniMax M3, and MiMo 2.5 added to free model picker. README.md and README.zh-CN.md updated to reflect new catalog and product matrix. DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 defaults CLI/Desktop; GPT-5.6 Luna defaults Web/Cloud/Chat. MiniMax M3 and MiMo 2.5 support image input.

6e392721fb79228f970577ee7d957562e282073f.title: CLI 1.0.683 release
6e392721fb79228f970577ee7d957562e282073f.summary: Version bump to 1.0.683 in cli/release/package.json. Routine release. No functional changes.

bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.title: CLI 1.0.682 adds first-time onboarding suggested prompts
bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.summary: CLI 1.0.682 introduces a new `suggested-prompts.tsx` component displaying clickable starter prompts for Freebuff users who have never submitted a prompt. The feature gates visibility on `IS_FREEBUFF` and a new `hasSubmittedFirstPrompt` boolean in `settings.ts`, retiring the prompts permanently after the first user interaction (typed or clicked) to prevent clutter. Shared label-column widths and hover previews ensure full prompt text is visible without obscuring the input field, while new analytics events track `SUGGESTED_PROMPT_SHOWN` and `SUGGESTED_PROMPT_CLICKED`.

477475a9e9f4723ccff8403fd2b739bf68b87c42.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 replaces Pro in free model picker
477475a9e9f4723ccff8403fd2b739bf68b87c42.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 replaces the undated DeepSeek V4 Pro entry across the free model catalog. The dated label reflects the GA build's distinct behavior from the previous preview, while the underlying wire ID remains auto-updating. Pro now shares the low/high/max reasoning ladder with Flash via DEEPSEEK_V4_REASONING_EFFORTS, exposing the full three-rung set previously limited to high/max. Context window mapping in agents/base-chat.ts and README tables updated; Flash remains DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID due to cost and premium pool constraints.

175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.title: /byok command routes CLI inference to user-provided provider keys
175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.summary: New `/byok` slash command lets Freebuff CLI users route inference to OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible endpoints via environment-variable keys. `cli/src/commands/byok.ts` implements the subcommand router, while `cli/src/utils/byok.ts` stores connection metadata. Selecting a BYOK connection bypasses Freebuff session polling, auth gates, and ad slots in `cli/src/app.tsx` and `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Credential arguments are redacted from command history, and switching sources resets the transcript to prevent cross-provider message-format corruption.

61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.title: CLI release 1.0.680
61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.summary: Version bump to 1.0.680. Adds MiMo Pro agents in `agents/base2/` and `agents/reviewer/`. Removes legacy `.agents/` CLI definitions including `claude-code-cli.ts` and `codex-cli.ts`. Updates `cli/src/` and `common/src/` for streak queries and session display.

98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.title: /dashboard command opens account hub
98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.summary: Added `/dashboard` slash command to CLI, aliasing `/usage`, `/stats`, `/streak` to open the Freebuff account hub in the browser. The hub is a Freebuff-only surface; Codebuff retains its separate credits-based `/usage`. `safeOpen` handles headless Linux and locked-down WSL by printing the URL as a fallback. New wire types in `common/src/types/freebuff-usage.ts` and summary builder in `common/src/util/freebuff-usage-summary.ts` support cross-surface usage data.

cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.title: Remove /connect command and ChatGPT OAuth integration
cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.summary: Removed slash command `/connect` and associated ChatGPT OAuth files (`chatgpt-connect-banner.tsx`, `chatgpt-oauth.ts`, `chatgpt-backend-fetch.ts`). Prompt builders for `/plan` and `/review` now force execution on the selected model, dropping the conditional delegation to `@thinker-gpt` when an account was connected. The `noThinkerGpt` flag in `createBase2` is replaced by a direct `!isFreebuff` check, and the `connect:chatgpt` input mode logic is stripped from the CLI router and input bar.

3dc7ec2306d94243ab2ba83ab457b59bcd4713c1.title: /queue adds CLI panel to edit, reorder, or delete queued messages
3dc7ec2306d94243ab2ba83ab457b59bcd4713c1.summary: New `/queue` slash command opens a full-screen panel for editing, reordering, and deleting queued messages. It takes the composer's place, with `Ctrl+Q` as the keyboard shortcut and no `/q` alias to avoid collision with the CLI quit command. QueuedMessage now carries a stable `id` field via `crypto.randomUUID()`, enabling the panel to address rows by identity across edits and reorders. Covers `cli/src/components/queue-panel.tsx`, `cli/src/state/queue-panel-store.ts`, `cli/src/utils/queue-panel-actions.ts`, plus `command-registry.ts`, `chat.tsx`, `use-message-queue.ts`, `use-chat-keyboard.ts`, and `use-chat-streaming.ts`.

b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.title: Refactor CLI slash command suggestion matcher
b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.summary: Extracted shared prefix and substring matching logic into `matchByIdOrAlias` in `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts`. Exported `filterSlashCommands` for testing. Covers CLI suggestion engine internals.

dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.title: Add /diagnostics command and improve Windows process termination
dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.summary: New /diagnostics command reports CLI resource usage and active terminal tool PIDs via cli/src/commands/process-diagnostics.ts. Terminal watchdog now uses taskkill.exe on Windows to force-terminate full descendant trees, preventing orphaned processes when Git Bash is killed. Focus state resets are removed from chat-store.ts to preserve terminal capabilities across sessions. SDK exports getActiveTerminalCommandProcesses to expose PIDs without leaking command text or environment secrets.

ce02985fc2dae21a5d6635d933952781273e3b33.title: Add /copy command to export conversation to clipboard
ce02985fc2dae21a5d6635d933952781273e3b33.summary: New `/copy` slash command serializes the current conversation (messages, reasoning, tool calls/results) into Markdown and writes to the system clipboard. Aliased as `/copy-chat` and `/export`. Registered in `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`, implemented in `cli/src/commands/copy-conversation.ts`. Remote sessions (OSC 52) enforce a 22 KB raw-text budget, progressively dropping large tool results/inputs to fit, while local sessions copy the full transcript.

2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.title: Document freebuff-web prod-smoke and Node pin
2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.summary: Added docs for `freebuff-web` prod-smoke in `docs/testing.md`, detailing the shared harness in `packages/internal/src/prod-smoke/harness.ts`. Explains the critical Node version pin (20.15.1) to prevent build breaks from root config overrides, and the chat-turn journey testing `@codebuff/sdk` integration.

3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.title: docs: production-runtime smoke in build-web
3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.summary: Added section to `docs/testing.md` describing `web/scripts/prod-smoke.ts` execution in `build-web`. Explains Node vs Bun runtime divergence causing `Promise.withResolvers()` failure (#3218). Details local execution via `bun run smoke:prod` requiring loopback Postgres.

4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.title: FreebuffSession adds env file sourcing
4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.summary: FreebuffSession.create now accepts an env option, materializing variables into a sourceable file within a dedicated temp directory. The tmux command prelude sources this file before launching the binary, preventing secrets from entering the indexed project directory or recorded command line. The stop method cleans up both the work directory and the new env directory. README documents a live smoke test procedure using this mechanism.

a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.title: Solar Pro 4 metered again
a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.summary: Solar Pro 4 reverted to metered pricing via SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES in freebuff-solar-promo.ts. OpenRouter price overrides in freebuff-models.ts now lack expiry dates, relying on Upstage's persistent 90% discount. Scope: common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts, common/src/constants/freebuff-solar-promo.ts. Detail: Entry takes effect 2026-09-13T05:00:00Z per server deployment.

217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.title: Add auto top-up link to CLI landing screen rate limit message
217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.summary: Updated FreebuffLandingScreen component to include a direct link to https://freebuff.com/freebucks when displaying rate limit warnings. This change provides users with an immediate option to enable auto top-up and continue working without interruption. The modification affects only cli/src/components/freebuff-landing-screen.tsx.

73b3e16cdc03da2402d2a3eed7e3bbec76b073f1.title: Add /reasoning command to set model thinking effort
73b3e16cdc03da2402d2a3eed7e3bbec76b073f1.summary: New `/reasoning` slash command (aliases `effort`, `think`) lets users read or set the thinking level for the selected Freebuff model. The command validates input against the local catalog ladder and persists the choice to `freebuff_reasoning_effort` in `codebuff_metadata` on subsequent requests, allowing mid-session changes without restarting. Implemented in `cli/src/commands/reasoning.ts` and registered in `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` as Freebuff-only.

abd23ca628058b352e08b9fc4028f775b2c72042.title: freebuff CLI 0.0.174
abd23ca628058b352e08b9fc4028f775b2c72042.summary: Version bump to 0.0.174 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Internal packaging update.

72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.title: SubscriptionCostReport adds observedHours and forecast observation
72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.summary: SubscriptionCostReport now tracks recent completed-hour metrics alongside daily totals. New fields `observedHours`, `forecastObservationStart`, and `forecastObservationEnd` separate measured hours from the complete-day basis used for forecasts. This change affects the shared `SubscriptionCostReport` interface in `common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts`. Consumers must handle the optional fields to distinguish partial UTC day coverage from full-day historical data.

51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.title: Add SubscriptionCostMetrics and SubscriptionCostReport types
51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.summary: New `common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts` defines `SubscriptionCostMetrics` and `SubscriptionCostReport` interfaces. These types standardize the shape of cost data for paid subscribers, covering net provider dollars, subscription-funded portions, unattributed costs, and 30-day forecasts. The `SubscriptionCostReport` includes cohort-level aggregates (`users`, `tiers`, `totals`) and metadata like `attributionComplete` to flag missing funding attribution. This is a shared core type addition, preparing the data layer for cost reporting features.

aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.title: Configurable sponsored compute acceptance price
aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.summary: Added FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_COMPUTE_ACCEPTANCE_PRICE_CENTS env var to override the hardcoded 200-cent acceptance fee. Defaults to 200 when absent; rejects malformed or non-positive integer values by closing admission. Logic moved to sponsoredComputeAcceptancePriceCents in common/src/ads/sponsored-compute-contract.ts. Enforced in readSponsoredComputePolicy before returning the frozen policy object.

dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.title: readfiles attaches images as media parts via requestImageFile
dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.summary: read_files now returns image files as base64 media parts instead of text, allowing the model to see the picture. This requires hosts to provide the new optional `requestImageFile` dependency in `AgentRuntimeScopedDeps`; without it, images fall back to the old text-read behavior which produces replacement characters. The SDK implements this for local filesystems in `sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts` and wires it through `sdk/src/run.ts`, while `common/src/tools/params/tool/read-files.ts` updates the output schema to accept media objects. Images exceeding `MAX_IMAGE_READ_BYTES` (derived from `MAX_IMAGE_BASE64_SIZE`) are rejected with a status line instructing the model to downscale them via terminal commands.

a784cf2d81b03b3074f794fb5acdcfcb18ef35fd.title: Add house subscription billing experiment split
a784cf2d81b03b3074f794fb5acdcfcb18ef35fd.summary: Added `houseSubscriptionBillingArmForUser` and `HOUSE_SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_EXPERIMENT` to `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts`. Implements a sticky 50/50 split between monthly and yearly billing for the Freebuff house-subscription promotion, using a dedicated dated salt (`house_subscription_billing_2026_09`) to isolate this acquisition experiment from ad routing. Assignment is deterministic via `fnv1a` hash of the salt and user ID, ensuring stability across sessions and pods.

28663a3cb73ad6b81408aa9cf131a8edf1f1f5ba.title: /export command added; compactContext idle trigger raised to 1h;
28663a3cb73ad6b81408aa9cf131a8edf1f1f5ba.summary: New `/export [filename]` writes the full conversation to disk, Markdown by default via `serializeConversation`, raw messages when the filename ends in `.json` using `serializeForPersistence`. Previously `/export` was only an alias of `/copy` (32 KB OSC 52 clipboard cap); the alias is removed from `command-registry.ts` and `slash-commands.ts` so `/copy` keeps only `copy-chat`. `DEFAULT_CACHE_EXPIRY_MS` in `compact-history.ts` rises 30m -> 1h, and `agents/base3.ts` sets `compactContext: { cacheExpiryMs: 3600000 }` explicitly. `run-agent-step.ts` now gates the history-replacing branch on `isCompactCommandPrompt` (same map that injects `compactPrompt`) and skips compaction when the model returns empty or think-only text, preventing total amnesia.

0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.title: Use tryGetProjectRoot in getRelativePath
0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.summary: getRelativePath in cli/src/utils/path-helpers.ts now calls tryGetProjectRoot instead of getProjectRoot. This avoids an uncaught throw when the project root is unset during early startup or tests, ensuring the fallback logic executes correctly.

a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.title: Add Gravity Showcase experiment telemetry types and ingest logic
a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.summary: Introduces `gravity-showcase-experiment.ts` defining assignment logic and `ads.showcase_presented` analytics event. Adds `createGravityShowcasePresentationTelemetry` in `axiom-only-log.ts` to validate client payloads against strict schema constraints. Updates `log-ingest.ts` to route `ADS_SHOWCASE_PRESENTED_EVENT` records through this validator, ensuring malformed data is dropped rather than retained in restricted branches. Scope covers shared core types, constants, and log ingestion utilities.

5f024bab305902dc778d74b92756ae6c96cb42f4.title: ADPOSTPAIDDEFAULTCREDITLINECENTS raised to 20000
5f024bab305902dc778d74b92756ae6c96cb42f4.summary: AD_POSTPAID_DEFAULT_CREDIT_LINE_CENTS raised from 10000 to 20000. AD_POSTPAID_COLLECTION_THRESHOLD_CENTS added at 10000, enforcing that collection must start before the minimum credit line can stop delivery. AD_CREDIT_LINE_MIN_GROWTH_STEP_CENTS decoupled from default line, hardcoded to 10000. Scope limited to common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts.

871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.title: Bump CLI version to 0.0.173
871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.summary: Version bumped to 0.0.173 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Standard release increment.

1dd01919a42648d9da8f473c4f84b3b0b55b8605.title: Removed format-validation-errors-for-message.ts
1dd01919a42648d9da8f473c4f84b3b0b55b8605.summary: Deleted `cli/src/utils/format-validation-errors-for-message.ts`. This utility handled formatting validation errors for chat messages, including relative path normalization and clickable link generation. Scope limited to CLI utils.

4aa36c7b25c32bdc0605e5abfc8529e306dc4dd7.title: Add iOS ad placements to shared constants
4aa36c7b25c32bdc0605e5abfc8529e306dc4dd7.summary: New `common/src/ads/ios-placements.ts` defines three native iOS ad slots: `iOS-Chat-After-Assistant-Message`, `iOS-Coding-After-User-Message`, and `iOS-Coding-After-Assistant-Message`. These are integrated into `PLACEMENT_SLOTS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts` with `surface: 'ios'` and `format: 'inline'`. Native inventory maintains its own attribution and is not aliased to web slots.

1fe7bfe3bb89a5f39ce493861f57c861565e81ed.title: Add concurrency and slotLimit to session admission refusals
1fe7bfe3bb89a5f39ce493861f57c861565e81ed.summary: FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse now includes optional concurrency and slotLimit fields for capacity refusals. This exposes the exact admission bucket and entitlement-derived limit to the client. Older servers omit these fields; clients must not guess limits. Scope: common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts.

ebc17a50dc3d760f6d6eb023df4abc508e1dbd9f.title: Add yearly billing intervals and Stripe price fields to subscription
ebc17a50dc3d760f6d6eb023df4abc508e1dbd9f.summary: Added `yearlyPriceUsd` to `FreebuffSubscriptionTier` and `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_INTERVALS` constants. Updated `FreebuffSubscriptionTierOffer` with optional `yearlyPurchasable` and `purchasable` flags to gate checkout availability. Extended `FreebuffSubscriptionInfo` with `billingInterval`, `renewsAt`, and `source` fields for legacy compatibility.

2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.title: model spend label and optional modelSpendUsd field
2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.summary: FREEBUFF_SPEND_UNIT_LABEL changes from 'tokens' to 'model spend' to disambiguate dollar ceilings from token counts in the account hub. FreebuffRecentUsage gains optional modelSpendUsd: number, an estimated list-price USD figure rounded to cents. The field is absent when FREEBUFF_MODEL_SPEND_AUDIENCE restricts dollar visibility, requiring clients to omit the card if undefined. Scope covers common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts and common/src/types/freebuff-usage.ts.

385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.title: Add wallet spend limit consent to CLI session start
385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.summary: New `consent_required` session status and `FreebuffWalletSpendLimit` type gate model starts. CLI sends limit via `FREEBUFF_WALLET_SPEND_LIMIT_HEADER` to `FREEBUFF_SESSION_ADMISSION_PATH`, throwing `session_admission_unsupported` on 404/405. `freebucksOf` now returns `null` for unavailable balances vs `undefined` for absent meters, fixing picker notice logic. `freebucksRowIntent` removed from `cli/src/utils/freebucks.ts`, replaced by `common/src/util/freebuff-model-selection.ts`.

2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.title: After-hours hero replaces Freebuff Pro house ad copy
2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.summary: New `assets/ads/freebuff-pro-after-hours.webp` and `md` replace the Freebuff Pro house ad copy in `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts`. The change aligns `Desktop-Spotlight` and `Desktop-Showcase` banners with the active subscription campaign, using plain titles ('Keep building', 'Code anywhere', 'Pick your model') to ensure correct rendering in the Showcase card, which lacks `splitMarkedTitle` support. Showcase and Spotlight now share a deduplicated creative pool, removing the previous session-count claims in favor of price-driven messaging.

af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.title: BYOK pin transition rule
af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.summary: run.ts allows hosted-to-BYOK transitions once while blocking BYOK-to-hosted reversals. Prevents credential changes on resumed runs. Scope: SDK only. Detail: previousInference.source 'codebuff' to 'byok' is permitted; other source mismatches fail.

6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.title: Add purchasesPaused flag and Desktop session pause messaging
6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.summary: New `purchasesPaused` boolean added to `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse` to distinguish server-side Desktop purchase pauses from model outages. `freebuff-models.ts` exports `freebuffPurchasesPausedModelMessage` and `freebuffPurchasesPausedAvailabilityLabel` to generate context-aware errors. Older binaries receive a scoped availability label preventing false model-down signals. Desktop multi-session path handles the flag; Web/CLI ignore it while rendering updated `availableHours`.

bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.title: Desktop idle timeout raised to 15m, new session headers
bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.summary: FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_IDLE_RELEASE_MS increased from 10 to 15 minutes in common/src/constants/freebuff-desktop-sessions.ts. Adds FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_ADMITTED_AT_HEADER and FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_ATTEMPT_HEADER to support stable tab pinning and idempotent POSTs. Scope limited to Desktop session slot management constants.

c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.title: Add updateRequired flag for legacy Desktop clients
c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.summary: Introduced `updateRequired` boolean to `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse` and helper functions in `freebuff-models.ts`. Signals legacy Desktop binaries cannot resume purchased time due to client version, not model failure. Prevents misleading 'model unavailable' errors by scoping refusal to client update. Only affects Desktop multi-session path; older clients ignore flag but render updated availability label.

e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.title: Imprezia client forwards end-user IP via X-Forwarded-For
e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.summary: Adds optional `clientIp` parameter to `postToImprezia`, `fetchImpreziaChatAd`, and `fetchImpreziaDisplayAd` in `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts`. The value is sent as `X-Forwarded-For` header, ensuring Imprezia targets and measures off the single end-user IP resolved by the server's proxy-aware resolver, never the raw chain. Scope limited to shared core ad client utilities. Detail: Header injection is conditional (`...(clientIp ? { 'X-Forwarded-For': clientIp } : {})`), preventing empty header spam when IP is unavailable.

cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.title: Sponsored procedure runtime inputs and advertiser CTA
cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.summary: Introduced `sponsoredProcedureRuntimeInputsSection` in `common/src/ads/sponsored-procedure-inputs.ts` to pass runtime values like `advertiserLink` to sponsored agents without altering the consent-covered procedure text. The CLI updates `buildSponsoredPrompt` and `SponsoredRun` to append this non-hashed section only when the procedure declares the `{{advertiserLink}}` placeholder. `SponsoredProposalBlock` now renders a sanitized advertiser CTA link as a separate text element. This mechanism prevents consent violations (COD-512) by keeping the SHA-256 hash of the procedure stable while injecting necessary campaign data.

81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.title: Ignore GHA OIDC credentials
81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.summary: Added `gha-creds-*.json` to `.gitignore` to exclude short-lived GitHub OIDC credentials generated for the IntentBuff runner. Prevents accidental commit of ephemeral auth tokens. Change scoped to repository hygiene via `.gitignore`.

5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.title: Solar Pro 4 price transition to 0 Freebucks
5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.summary: SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES adds a transition setting FREEBUFF_SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL_ID price to 0 at 2026-09-09T15:49:00Z. Comment updated to note past prices are preserved for historical accounting. Changes in common/src/constants/freebuff-solar-promo.ts. Transitions travel with server quote for idle client updates.

df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.title: Solar Pro 4 endpoint switches to non-ZDR upstage
df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.summary: SOLAR_PRO_4_OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT changed from 'upstage/zdr' to 'upstage' in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Upstage requested the non-ZDR route for provider-side debugging. The dataUse: 'service' comment clarifies this does not permit AI training or enable trace storage.

b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.title: Add purchase continuity claim types and refund metadata
b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.summary: Added x-freebuff-purchase-continuity header and new session admission statuses purchase_claim_released, purchase_in_use, and purchase_capacity. Instance IDs now act as single-use execution claims requiring persisted IDs for retry. Common types include desktopPurchases and desktopRefunds interfaces exposing claimInstanceIds, poolDate, and expiredBonusAmount. CLI nextDelayMs handles new statuses by returning null.

4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.title: Sponsored runs fix Linux git mounts and clarify CLI error codes
4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.summary: Sponsored runs on Linux now mount an empty tmpfs over the linked worktree's common dir and rebind existing entries read-only, keeping `packed-refs` hidden and `packed-refs.lock` in the tmpfs to allow git commits without rewriting the ref table. The CLI `sponsored-proposal-api.ts` now maps upstream machine codes like `funded_accept_required` to human-readable sentences instead of displaying the raw enum. `sdk/src/run.ts` fixes the `OverrideToolHandlers` type by excluding `read_files` from the mapped half, resolving an unsatisfiable intersection that previously forced callers to cast to `never`. `common/src/ads/supabase-format-experiment.ts` introduces a `SupabaseFormatPair` registry to centralize campaign IDs and procedure hashes, preventing drift across serving paths.

54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.title: CLI package version bump to 0.0.172
54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.summary: Version incremented to 0.0.172 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Routine release preparation.

6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.title: Move Earn constants to freebuff-earn.ts
6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.summary: Extracted `FREEBUFF_EARN_PATH`, `FREEBUFF_EARN_PROMPT`, and `FREEBUFF_EARN_PROMPT_SHORT` from `common/src/constants/freebuff-levels.ts` into new file `common/src/constants/freebuff-earn.ts`. Trust and Levels ladder retired, but Earn page persists; constants moved to prevent deletion. CLI banner `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` updated to import from new path. `FREEBUFF_EARN_PROMPT` now reads `Earn Freebucks · engage with a promoted post`.

7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.title: imprezia-client error log includes response body detail
7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.summary: `postToImprezia` now captures and logs the first 300 characters of the response body when an error status is returned. This addresses a blind spot where generic 400/500 errors lacked context, making upstream rejection causes unknowable from logs. The change is scoped to `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts`. Body reading is defensive (`.catch(() => null)`) to ensure log enrichment never disrupts the ad fetch flow.

a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.title: Remove unused message tree utilities from CLI
a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.summary: Deleted getDescendantIds, getAncestorIds, and isAgentVisible from cli/src/utils/message-tree-utils.ts. These functions handled agent visibility and tree traversal but are no longer referenced. Scope limited to CLI internal utilities; buildMessageTree remains unchanged.

17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.title: CLI session refund tracking and coalesced release
17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.summary: CLI session lifecycle now tracks refunds explicitly via `lastRefund` and `refundPending` in `useFreebuffSession`. The store coalesces exit, unmount, and explicit `/end-session` calls for the same authenticated instance to prevent race conditions. If a release fails, the chat and held instance persist so a retry can recover the server-credited refund receipt. Covers `cli/src/state/freebuff-session-store.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`, and landing screen UI.

95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.title: Restore premium session base limit to 5
95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.summary: FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT reverted from 4 to 5 in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts following Level retirement. FREEBUFF_PRE_LEVELS_* constants and their documentation removed from common/src/constants/freebuff-levels.ts. Base limit now matches pre-Level value directly, eliminating the need for the rollback lever.

abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.title: Fix Freebucks intro keypress bug and paywall row interaction in CLI
abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.summary: Fixed a bug where dismissing the one-time Freebucks intro card simultaneously committed the focused model row, causing unintended session charges. The intro card now owns the keyboard via `useFreebucksIntro` state in `freebuff-landing-screen.tsx`, suspending `FreebuffModelSelector` input while visible. Additionally, priced-out rows are now pressable to display paywall messages and plans links instead of remaining inert. Changes affect `freebucks-intro-card.tsx`, `freebuff-landing-screen.tsx`, and `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`.

04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.title: CLI model picker adds peak pricing badge
04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.summary: The CLI model selector now renders a dedicated 'Peak pricing' badge and tooltip for models carrying a surcharge, replacing the previous prose-only `priceNotices` override. This change introduces `freebucksPeakCopy` in a new `common/src/util/freebuff-peak-price.ts` file to format the surcharge amount, window duration, and base price return time in the user's local timezone, avoiding hard-coded Pacific Time references. The update affects `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` and extends `FreebuffFreebucksInfo` in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` with a `peak` object containing `modelIds`, `surcharge`, and `endsAt`. The utility is isolated in `util/` to bypass export leak checks that prevent public CLI files from importing private constants modules.

f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.title: Chat thinker switches to GPT-5.6 Luna with xhigh reasoning
f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.summary: The `thinker-gemini` agent definition in `agents/thinker/thinker-gemini.ts` now uses `FREEBUFF_GPT_5_6_LUNA_MODEL_ID` and sets `reasoningOptions.effort` to `xhigh`. This replaces the previous DeepSeek V4 Flash configuration and its `high` effort setting. The `effort` type union in `agents/types/agent-definition.ts` and related template files in `common/src` expands to include `'max'` and `'xhigh'`, ensuring schema validation accepts the new values. The agent ID remains `thinker-gemini` to preserve registration and prompt compatibility.

3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.title: Retire daily spend ceilings, shift to session pacing
3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.summary: Removed `monthlySpendLimitUsd` from subscription tiers and deleted `freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts`, replacing hard daily spend caps with soft session pacing. Legacy `turn_spend_limit` errors are now compatibility notices, as current servers use pacing instead of refusing prompts. The CLI header no longer displays monthly usage left, and `FREEBUFF_PER_MODEL_SESSION_SPEND_CAPS` now defines optional pacing targets that add pauses rather than blocking calls. This change spans `common/src/constants`, `cli/src/utils`, and `common/src/types`.

4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.title: On-meter spend ceiling skips elevated country and trust level budgets
4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.summary: resolveFreebuffSpendCeiling in common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts now excludes elevated_country and trust_level cohorts when onFreebucksMeter is true. This prevents lower session-era ceilings from incorrectly blocking accounts with remaining Freebucks. Abuse cohorts remain active as fences. Fixes false exhaustion reports for 57 accounts on 2026-09-05.

ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.title: Bump freebuff CLI to 0.0.171
ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.summary: Freebuff CLI version bumped from 0.0.170 to 0.0.171 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. This is a standard patch release increment. Scope limited to the CLI package metadata.

f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.title: Freebucks daily compute cap raised to 4x
f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.summary: Freebucks ceiling notice updated to reflect compute cap raised from 3x to 4x of Freebucks value. Change applies to FREEBUFF_FREEBUCKS_CEILING_NOTICE in common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts. Adjusts daily usage limit for accounts using Freebucks.

872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.title: Advertiser reason redaction v2 adds country exclusion codes
872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.summary: ADVERTISER_REASON_REDACTION_VERSION bumps to v2. Adds country_excluded and country_unresolved to operator and safe code lists. Serves visible reasons directly to advertisers since they own the underlying country rules. Distinguishes explicit exclusion from placement failure for targeted action.

f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.title: Add ADSMCPTOOLCALLEVENT to axiom-only logging
f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.summary: Added `ADS_MCP_TOOL_CALL_EVENT` ('ads.mcp_tool_call') to `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts` for advertiser MCP operation census. Defines strict allowlist schema `ADS_MCP_TOOL_CALL_FIELDS` (advertiser_id, key_id, tool, outcome, error_code, duration_ms) and registers handler in `getAxiomOnlyLogEvent` to sanitize records. Scope limited to Shared/Core logging utility; no CLI or Web surface changes. Ensures content-free telemetry by excluding arguments and results from logged events.

5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.title: Split limited tier hero and coercion target constants
5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash becomes the limited tier hero via new `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_HERO_MODEL_ID`, while `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` remains DeepSeek V4 Flash as the coercion target. The split resolves a conflict where a locked hero (due to earned reward metering) caused first-press failures, allowing safe recommendation of the cheaper GLM model while preserving a joinable fallback. Updates affect `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and `README.md` limited access descriptions.

54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.title: CLI Freebucks header adds daily reset countdown
54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.summary: The CLI Freebucks header now displays a countdown to the daily pool refill (e.g., `resets in 4h 12m`) when a current timestamp is provided. This aligns the CLI's metered account display with the Web and Desktop pickers, which already show this figure. The change is implemented in `cli/src/utils/freebucks.ts` via a new `freebucksResetCountdown` helper and updated `freebucksHeaderLine`, with `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` passing the `now` timestamp to trigger the display.

253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.title: Derive free promotion spend windows from price schedule
253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.summary: New `common/src/constants/freebuff-free-promotions.ts` derives `FREEBUFF_FREE_PROMOTION_SPEND_WINDOWS` from `SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES`. Windows open at price 0 transitions and close at next non-zero, merging re-announcements to prevent drift between free status and allowance exemption. Fixes Solar Pro 4 weekend bug where free usage consumed daily dollar budget. `isFreePromotionSpendAt` provides runtime check; `message.cost` remains untouched for provider accounting.

e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.title: Remove GPT-5.6 Luna from global Pro-only catalog
e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna removed from `FREEBUFF_PRO_ONLY_CATALOG_MODEL_IDS` in `freebuff-models.ts`. This decouples the global paid boundary from the limited-tier plan lock, allowing full-access users to spend premium allowance on Luna across CLI and Desktop while keeping it locked at limited access. `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_PRO_MODEL_IDS` in `freebuff-subscriptions.ts` now exclusively contains Gemini 3.8 Flash, reflecting its status as a Web-only paid row. The change prevents Luna from becoming globally Pro-only due to its narrower limited-tier restriction.

8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.title: Clarify turnspendlimit error message
8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.summary: FREEBUFF_TURN_SPEND_LIMIT_MESSAGE shortened to remove speculative agent-loop diagnosis. Comment updated to drop 'not a quota' clause, reflecting that limit is purely spend-based. Affects shared constants consumed by Web, CLI, and Desktop clients via freebuff-errors.ts.

d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.title: freebuff 0.0.169
d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.summary: Version bump to 0.0.169 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Internal packaging update.

6c846b9d1e27bda1da35cfbe900f062eefb7e2b2.title: CLI adds Freebucks metered model picker, intro card, status bar
6c846b9d1e27bda1da35cfbe900f062eefb7e2b2.summary: CLI surfaces Freebucks metering via `freebucks-intro-card.tsx` and `freebucks.ts` utilities. Landing screen shows one-time intro if metered, gated by `terminalHeight >= 30`. Model selector adds `metered` section, `pendingAsk` state, and sorts by price. Session-ended banner and status bar display Freebucks balance, replacing session count when metered.

02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.title: Add Freebuff Pro sponsor break creatives and hero asset
02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.summary: Added `HOUSE_BREAK_AD_VARIATIONS` and hero assets for Freebuff Pro sponsor breaks. Uses placement IDs instead of surfaces to separate break creatives from inline floors. Hero images are uploaded via seed script, avoiding static paths for `imageUrl`.

e6c61f451394b49df437af776c496a0365474fd6.title: Solar Pro 4 0 Freebucks promo Sep 5-7 PT
e6c61f451394b49df437af776c496a0365474fd6.summary: Solar Pro 4 price drops to 0 Freebucks Sep 5-7 PT via server-announced `SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES` in `freebuff-solar-promo.ts`. `applyFreebucksPriceChanges` in `freebuff-price-changes.ts` mutates `prices` and `priceNotices` on session load; `getFreebucksInfo` and `getFreebuffModelMeter` apply it. CLI picker `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` uses `taglineFor` to override static taglines with `priceNotices`; `use-freebuff-session.ts` schedules refresh at `nextFreebucksPriceChange`. Promo reverts to 5 Freebucks Sep 8 via `SOLAR_REGULAR_OFFER`.

c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.title: Carry freebucks block on CLI refusals; day-scale retry formatting
c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.summary: CLI landing screen now renders day-scale wait times (e.g. '26 days' instead of '622h 18m') for monthly reset waits. The `useFreebuffSession` hook carries the `freebucks` block from the previous state onto `rate_limited` and `spend_limited` responses, fixing a bug where the monthly wall displayed raw dollar values instead of metered session counts. Updates apply to `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`, `cli/src/components/freebuff-landing-screen.tsx`, and `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. The server does not send the `freebucks` block on refusals; the client must persist it to maintain accurate UI metering.

52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.title: Update .gitignore to allow .env.local.example
52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.summary: Added `!.env.local.example` to `.gitignore` to prevent exclusion of local environment template files. Also ignored `xcuserdata/` and `.claude/settings.local.json` to reduce repo noise. Scope limited to repository configuration.

76a5696e5fdd93b9dc8dded8d2d0c8fac82937ab.title: GLM 5.3 Flash becomes default model; peak-closure badge logic split
76a5696e5fdd93b9dc8dded8d2d0c8fac82937ab.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Flash as the default model across CLI, Web, and Desktop pickers in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Saved preferences migrate via new `FREEBUFF_DEFAULT_MODEL_MIGRATION_ID` `glm-5.3-flash-2026-09-05`. Limited-tier hero remains DeepSeek V4 Flash because GLM is earned-metered at limited access. `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts` splits `isFreebuffWebPeakClosedProModelId` from `isFreebuffWebProClosedNow` to fix picker badges incorrectly showing hours for Luna and Gemini 3.8 Flash.

a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.title: Add accent-span parser and sponsor break frequency copy
a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.summary: New `common/src/ads/accent-span.ts` introduces a strict parser for sponsor break headline accents, ensuring unvouched titles render as plain text to prevent markup leakage in CLI/Web surfaces. `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts` adds `SPONSOR_BREAK_FREQUENCY_COPY` to clarify daily impression caps and hardcodes format-specific labels for `Desktop-Spotlight` and `CLI-Dock` slots. The parser refuses multi-span inputs, forcing advertisers to author single-word emphasis or accept plain rendering.

2cd4966460ec52724504da1424e2aaa7f56b6e95.title: Add isSponsorBreakEvent and isInterruptingBreakFormat predicates
2cd4966460ec52724504da1424e2aaa7f56b6e95.summary: New `isSponsorBreakEvent` validates untrusted input against `SPONSOR_BREAK_EVENTS` to prevent cardinality widening in break readouts. `isInterruptingBreakFormat` and `isInterruptingBreakPlacement` isolate `spotlight` and `intermission` from `showcase`, decoupling daily cap logic from creative shape requirements. `dismiss_lock_ms` documentation clarifies shared usage across Spotlight (COD-454) and Showcase (COD-455). Changes confined to `common/src/ads/sponsor-break-events.ts` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`.

f1654d2c20dcf2cc75a464b7c6707d1cfeef6711.title: Remove experimental flag from Solar Pro 4 model definition
f1654d2c20dcf2cc75a464b7c6707d1cfeef6711.summary: Dropped `experimental: true` from `SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. This promotes Solar Pro 4 to standard access, removing any experimental UI indicators or gating. Scope limited to shared core constants; no CLI, Web, or Desktop picker logic changes required.

7d386183ac1fba92b91d0fd6116ed7f61dbacd6d.title: Clarify nextBonusAt semantics and bonus expiry
7d386183ac1fba92b91d0fd6116ed7f61dbacd6d.summary: Updated `FreebuffFreebucksWallet` type documentation in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. `nextBonusAt` now explicitly denotes current period end, remaining present during scheduled cancellation but absent without a live plan. Bonus expiry logic clarified: unspent monthly bonus retires only upon next period credit (including upgrades), not merely on subscription end.

20289ffb12000c10fd26cd3735849066e963d1cc.title: Add clickidshape field to Axiom postback logs
20289ffb12000c10fd26cd3735849066e963d1cc.summary: Added click_id_shape field and validation logic to ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_EVENT logging in common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts. New sanitizeExternalConversionPostbackFields function ensures only valid shapes (missing, wrong_type, empty, oversized, control_char) are logged, stripping invalid values. This enhances observability into click-id validation failures while maintaining privacy constraints.

b9d72aecc22730807ca4c2d450c9f9b1c0c6739b.title: Add sponsor break dismiss lock telemetry
b9d72aecc22730807ca4c2d450c9f9b1c0c6739b.summary: Added `dismiss_lock_ms` and `lock_completed` fields to `SponsorBreakEventPayload` to track SPOTLIGHT dismissal lock duration and expiry status. Implemented `clampSponsorBreakDismissLockMs` with bounds 0-5000ms, allowing 0 as a kill switch for immediate dismissal. This separates lock metrics from countdown timer metrics to prevent silent re-tuning of different ad formats.

b8a55e9b61345917b0f8b470e4c02ab4f4956d4f.title: Sponsored compute contract and API key log redaction
b8a55e9b61345917b0f8b470e4c02ab4f4956d4f.summary: New `SponsoredComputeGrant` and `SponsoredComputePolicy` types define the response shape and server config for sponsored compute, enforcing a $2 acceptance fee and $0.50 compute cap. `readSponsoredComputePolicy` validates `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_COMPUTE_*` env vars, rejecting incomplete policies or invalid UUIDs. `getUserInfoFromApiKey` in `sdk/src/impl/database.ts` now omits the `apiKey` from error logs to prevent credential leakage. `SponsoredProposalRow` gains an optional `conversationId` to link offers to their source thread.

fb0ab0941b7c17b23b57e0d950f836d852c4d912.title: CLI Freebucks meter UI updates and intro persistence fix
fb0ab0941b7c17b23b57e0d950f836d852c4d912.summary: Landing screen and referral banner components now render Freebucks-specific notices and labels when the account is metered, replacing legacy session limit warnings. The `freebucksHeaderLine` and `freebucksPriceLabel` utilities were updated to explicitly name the currency and clarify monthly usage allowances. A critical fix in `settings.ts` adds `freebucksIntroSeenAt` to the allowlist, preventing the intro dismissal state from being dropped on load. Scope covers `cli/src/components` and `cli/src/utils`.

88e05db4b26f8e58eca99dbae7cf8ef26f22d0a5.title: Sponsor break events, placement formats, and experiment arms
