This bounds damage from weak-signal abuse while avoiding false-positive bans, as low ceilings keep suspicious traffic flowing through honeypots and fanout counters for stronger evidence.

0029f0a29f01837307120b1212694ffaa2899474.title: privacyegress signal added to spend ceiling resolver
0029f0a29f01837307120b1212694ffaa2899474.summary: Freebuff's spend ceiling resolver now gates fresh sessions based on anonymizing egress signals (VPN, proxy, Tor) via a new `privacyEgress` input flag and `privacy_egress` reason. The restricted daily spend ceiling was lowered from $1.00 to $0.50 to maintain detection visibility while limiting return frequency for flagged accounts. This change applies to `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts` and affects how fresh sessions are initiated for users on privacy-focused networks, excluding benign signals like Apple Private Relay.

9c97c4b81c451b11472f72068b175d485a9512a8.title: withTimeout clears timer on all paths
9c97c4b81c451b11472f72068b175d485a9512a8.summary: withTimeout now uses try/finally to clearTimeout on both resolve and reject paths. Previous implementation only cleared timer on success, leaking handles on timeout. Affects common/src/util/promise.ts. timeoutId typed as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined for cross-platform correctness.

43db7ec34405a23491b376662bf243226a136619.title: Remove database-request-cost.ts
43db7ec34405a23491b376662bf243226a136619.summary: Deleted `common/src/util/database-request-cost.ts` (-863 lines). Removed database request cost evaluation, budget definitions, and APL query builder. Internal refactoring of shared core utilities.

6eb9bf8e4038d432a370d0186b0d124fe912fabe.title: SDK run.ts drops unanswered tool calls at persistence boundary
6eb9bf8e4038d432a370d0186b0d124fe912fabe.summary: sdk/src/run.ts imports and applies dropUnansweredToolCalls to state.mainAgentState.messageHistory before saving checkpoints. This ensures that assistant tool calls lacking results are removed from the persisted history, preventing structural errors on resume. The change targets the SDK persistence layer to guarantee valid message history for resumed runs.

1fca3e29a75dddac2d4b2fc694f8f13a42b51253.title: Drop <usermessage> XML wrapper
1fca3e29a75dddac2d4b2fc694f8f13a42b51253.summary: Removes `asUserMessage` and `wrapContentForUserMessage`. `buildUserMessageContent` now returns raw text parts instead of injecting `<user_message>` tags. `formatPrompt` identifies user inputs via `tags` array rather than parsing XML. Covers agent-runtime templates/util and SDK `run.ts`.

c6d10a5bff56b7a83bd09e507bc5adc2a373c8dc.title: Add collection question and answer to FREEBUFFPUBLICDATAUSECOPY
c6d10a5bff56b7a83bd09e507bc5adc2a373c8dc.summary: Added collectionQuestion and collectionAnswer keys to FREEBUFF_PUBLIC_DATA_USE_COPY in common/src/constants/freebuff-data-use.ts. Clarifies that Freebuff is ad-supported and does not collect traces or files unless the model provider does, currently applying only to DeepSeek models. Scope limited to Shared/Core constants. No migration or behavioral changes required.

7db20c99a59d3ee3b410142d90b0f781f3861cc3.title: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.149
7db20c99a59d3ee3b410142d90b0f781f3861cc3.summary: Version bumped to 0.0.149 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Prepares new release build. Scope limited to CLI package metadata.

cef314aab409b9198cc4f5665e4a52da528c4eb4.title: CLI referral banner targets referral status tab
cef314aab409b9198cc4f5665e4a52da528c4eb4.summary: Updated `EARN_URL` and `DASHBOARD_LABEL` in `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` to link directly to the referral status section (`/earn?tab=referrals#referral-status`) instead of the generic Earn landing page. The label changed from 'Open GLM 5.2 dashboard' to 'Open referral status' to accurately reflect the destination. This ensures the CLI banner directs users to the specific referral tracking view rather than the broader earn interface.

204d98237e29a1004f52c2d7d6beac9cfbb9f694.title: Relax imageUrlFromData tag check and guard against double data: prefix
204d98237e29a1004f52c2d7d6beac9cfbb9f694.summary: The `imageUrlFromData` function in the OpenAI-compatible message converter now accepts plain string URLs in addition to `URL` instances, fixing a bug where valid string-tagged URLs were not recognized. It also short-circuits for strings already carrying a `data:` scheme or HTTP(S) URL, preventing a double `data:image/png;base64,data:...` prefix that caused provider 400 errors. The change is isolated to `convert-to-openai-compatible-chat-messages.ts` within the LLM providers package.

ad5d3005fb7f08e572e6fe8323303b26497795e1.title: Add desktop analytics events for thread archival and delivery conflict
ad5d3005fb7f08e572e6fe8323303b26497795e1.summary: Added DESKTOP_THREADS_AUTO_ARCHIVED and DESKTOP_DELIVERY_CONFLICT_CHANGED to AnalyticsEvent enum. These track background lifecycle outcomes for desktop sessions. Counts are bucketed and conflict changes emit only on transitions to prevent cardinality or volume churn from periodic scans.

80bc9c895dd73f9996ae18af67432e9ae1b09181.title: dropUnansweredToolCalls replaces filterUnfinishedToolCalls across SDK
80bc9c895dd73f9996ae18af67432e9ae1b09181.summary: Replaced `filterUnfinishedToolCalls` with `dropUnansweredToolCalls` in `common/src/util/messages.ts` and updated imports in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-utils.ts`. The new function mirrors AI SDK's validator by dropping local tool calls unanswered before the next user/system boundary or end of history, preventing restored SDK state or auxiliary calls from permanently poisoning threads. Provider-executed calls are excluded from pending tracking, and freestanding tool results are preserved.

fc178cb1ef7c7d06ee0bf55e88a7b6415f2cb291.title: Remove onboarding bypass cookie and TTL constants
fc178cb1ef7c7d06ee0bf55e88a7b6415f2cb291.summary: Deleted `ONBOARDING_BYPASS_COOKIE` and `ONBOARDING_BYPASS_TTL_SECONDS` from `common/src/constants/freebuff-onboarding-gate.ts`. These constants previously defined a 24-hour escape hatch for failed onboarding saves. The removal simplifies the onboarding gate logic by eliminating the bypass mechanism.

c0e5740f4ee47c3c7dd3fe6f890b2fc5b26b34d7.title: AI SDK 7 compatibility for v4 image data
c0e5740f4ee47c3c7dd3fe6f890b2fc5b26b34d7.summary: Updated packages/llm-providers to support AI SDK 7 by moving `ai` to devDependencies and adding `imageUrlFromData` in `convert-to-openai-compatible-chat-messages.ts`. This handles the v4 tagged file data shape passed through the compatibility proxy to the v2 implementation. The change ensures correct conversion of `data` and `url` types into base64 or string URLs, and supports the new `image` media type alias.

a801ecf452f6262853055d6aafb484bf3a74ec3c.title: GPT-5.6 Luna tagline change to Strong all-around
a801ecf452f6262853055d6aafb484bf3a74ec3c.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna `tagline` changed from 'Balanced' to 'Strong all-around' in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Update reflects Luna's positioning as general-purpose premium option, distinguished by Images badges. Scope limited to shared core constants.

190ac96c3428bfbd1ea3ffbdeaf77659f088a902.title: Copy command adds OSC 52 fallback and aborts stale clipboard ops
190ac96c3428bfbd1ea3ffbdeaf77659f088a902.summary: CLI copy-conversation now falls back to OSC 52 bounded rendering when native clipboard tools (pbcopy/xclip) are unavailable, rather than failing or silently skipping. Selection changes in use-clipboard.ts abort prior pending copy operations via AbortController to prevent stale clipboard restoration. The clipboard utility tracks active operations globally and uses SIGKILL on timed-out backends to release pipes, ensuring broken display servers do not freeze the TUI.

8057a82e406417ae68791f4ca8e5e26bb812be03.title: FREEBUFFWEBDEEMPHASIZEDMODELIDS emptied
8057a82e406417ae68791f4ca8e5e26bb812be03.summary: FREEBUFF_WEB_DEEMPHASIZED_MODEL_IDS in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts is now empty. MiniMax M3 removed because compact styling next to full-size rows appeared broken rather than de-emphasized. M3 retains its supersededBy notice for steering. Future muting requires pairs of rows to be visually effective.

7ef9669a46ffdb16f461c281a67ac52e4d3b9560.title: Document global-jsdom load-order flake and restore rules
7ef9669a46ffdb16f461c281a67ac52e4d3b9560.summary: Added section detailing file-order dependency in `test-freebuff-desktop` caused by `global-jsdom` caching `KEYS` at module scope. Explains how leaked `requestAnimationFrame` stubs in earlier suites poisoned subsequent React tests, leading to cascading failures. Defines two rules: delete global keys when restoring (not assign `undefined`) and use `test/support/jsdom.ts` for isolated DOM globals.

c7ddc18ceedc4938f6df6f859c14e98de8ad0562.title: Reorder model picker to lead with DeepSeek V4 Pro
c7ddc18ceedc4938f6df6f859c14e98de8ad0562.summary: Reordered `FREEBUFF_MODELS` constant to place `DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL` before `DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL`. This aligns the picker display order with the `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` flip on 2026-08-12, ensuring the recommended default appears first. Updated `README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md`, and `freebuff/cli/release/README.md` to reflect the new model ordering.

a0a9a4c80ae8b8aba38b449aa29ad9e214633c43.title: Add extended-context -max roots for DeepSeek V4 and Luna
a0a9a4c80ae8b8aba38b449aa29ad9e214633c43.summary: Added `base2-free-deepseek-pro-max`, `base2-free-deepseek-flash-max`, and `base2-free-luna-max` to `FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS` and `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` in `free-agents.ts`. These extended-context `-max` tiers are provisioned per-account rather than rendered from client catalogs, so they remain absent from `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and quota lists to prevent unavailable rows. The change defines the corresponding wire IDs in `freebuff-models.ts` and pins one model per root to satisfy hierarchy checks.

42f9dcb2036fe5685daf5f73da59512789e1f5c8.title: CLI release version 0.0.147
42f9dcb2036fe5685daf5f73da59512789e1f5c8.summary: freebuff/cli/release/package.json version bumped 0.0.146 to 0.0.147. Packaging metadata update for CLI release artifact. No code logic changes.

0d865059f023cea0d49fd9dce302ed1762f196c8.title: Onboarding gate bypass cookie replaces seen flag after save failures
0d865059f023cea0d49fd9dce302ed1762f196c8.summary: Renamed ONBOARDING_SEEN_COOKIE to ONBOARDING_BYPASS_COOKIE in freebuff-onboarding-gate.ts. The bypass cookie now sets only after save failures, not on arrival, preventing infinite redirect loops during outages. TTL reduced from 180 days to 24 hours in common/src/constants. Validation in freebuff-onboarding.ts now rejects empty optionIds with 'Please choose an option.' errors, enforcing required answers.

603b0d994dece07838c774cb022529dee7a28f1d.title: CLI dashboard button focus and streak glyphs
603b0d994dece07838c774cb022529dee7a28f1d.summary: Dashboard button focus now uses accent color and bold attributes instead of a leading marker. Two-column leading gutter separates labels from copy controls to prevent visual overlap during keyboard navigation. Streak progress glyphs revert to ●/○ from •/· to ensure distinct filled-vs-hollow states. Updates affect cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx and cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts.

79d6a9de6e44b00e4d484725b74991122ae257ab.title: CLIHARNESS base3 ships DEFAULT LITE picker models
79d6a9de6e44b00e4d484725b74991122ae257ab.summary: CLI_HARNESS constant in cli/src/utils/constants.ts flips base2 to base3. DEFAULT, LITE, and every Freebuff picker model now route to base3 roots. MAX and PLAN stay on base2. Rollback needs new CLI release since CLI lacks server-side kill switch. getFreebuffCliAgentIdForModel helper added in cli/src/utils/freebuff-agent-selection.ts.

e43fdc88870d851ec92b669dbba00bd5ffe17d0d.title: Muse Spark fallback switches to DeepSeek V4 Pro
e43fdc88870d851ec92b669dbba00bd5ffe17d0d.summary: MUSE_SPARK_FALLBACK_MODEL_ID now points to FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL_ID, replacing GPT-5.6 Luna. Pro is DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_WEB_MODEL_ID, aligning reroutes with new thread defaults while staying in FREEBUFF_WEB_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS. Text-only limitation handled by completions layer vision description conversion via getFreebuffModelImageSupport. README tables updated for Web/Cloud/Chat default status and native image support distinctions.

d9ee7bfc3e52b9156522bc86250fc7376f9fe955.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 replaces Flash as default model
d9ee7bfc3e52b9156522bc86250fc7376f9fe955.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 now serves as the default model across all surfaces via DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID, replacing V4 Flash 07/31. The CLI selector logic was updated to detect unstartable premium picks and automatically fallback to the unlimited Flash model when the daily premium pool is exhausted, ensuring the hero row remains joinable. Taglines were adjusted to reflect this hierarchy, with Pro claiming 'Smartest' and Flash stepping down to 'Smart & Fast'. Updated documentation in README.md, README.zh-CN.md, and freebuff/cli/release/README.md reflects the new default and fallback behavior.

d0a5d3f4e4a0caaee723ea2e10499a9c3b64b0fc.title: freebuff 0.0.146
d0a5d3f4e4a0caaee723ea2e10499a9c3b64b0fc.summary: Version bump to 0.0.146 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. Prepares release metadata.

4da4570dc9d90c75467c5d5541882cd919481bf0.title: Add Human Behavior env vars to client schema
4da4570dc9d90c75467c5d5541882cd919481bf0.summary: Adds NEXT_PUBLIC_HUMANBEHAVIOR_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_HUMANBEHAVIOR_INGESTION_URL to clientEnvSchema in common/src/env-schema.ts. Enables session-replay ingestion for Freebuff Web. API key is optional to allow dev checkouts to boot without replay. Ingestion URL overrides SDK default host.

df226b46771c1d64d1f4fd9f7e11e7996e47cba5.title: Add provisioned extended-context model rows
df226b46771c1d64d1f4fd9f7e11e7996e47cba5.summary: Added internal model definitions for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash and GPT-5.6 Luna extended-context variants in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. These rows exist solely for provisioning tooling and support lookups, explicitly excluded from `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and quota lists to prevent unauthorized client selection. Bumped `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` to version 0.0.148.

c1ff21d02571b1a923041ad489802f64a1514bca.title: Add standing field to FreebuffSessionServerResponse
c1ff21d02571b1a923041ad489802f64a1514bca.summary: Added optional standing?: FreebuffStandingInfo to FreebuffSessionServerResponse in common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts. Provides account Access Level and current limits on pre-join responses to render picker context. Clients must conditionally render based on presence as field is absent when feature disabled.

fe30ebff1d8856788874e037cf2b741f95b6ead3.title: CLI handles onboarding required error
fe30ebff1d8856788874e037cf2b741f95b6ead3.summary: Added `isFreebuffOnboardingRequiredError` and `getFreebuffOnboardingRequiredMessage` to `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`. `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts` checks this error before gate/rate-limit branches, treating it as terminal. New constants in `common/src/constants/freebuff-onboarding-gate.ts` define the 403 code and cutover logic. `common/src/constants/freebuff-onboarding.ts` defines the questionnaire structure. CLI surfaces a specific message instead of a retry countdown when accounts owe answers.

b07e38d987cc4aa41a1c0fea1a2502a462f0f50f.title: Remove onboarding gate and simplify validation
b07e38d987cc4aa41a1c0fea1a2502a462f0f50f.summary: Onboarding is no longer a blocking permission check. `isFreebuffOnboardingRequiredError` and related CLI handling are removed from `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts` and `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`. The `common/src/constants/freebuff-onboarding-gate.ts` logic shifts from a cutover-based requirement to a simple `enabled` boolean flag, removing the `accountCreatedAt` dependency. `common/src/constants/freebuff-onboarding.ts` updates `OnboardingValidationError` to allow `null` for `questionId` when the entire submission is empty, and removes per-question hints.

bab9f2907dff6c3f090b3ba645f64c91e95e997e.title: Add subscriptions question and exclusive option logic to onboarding
bab9f2907dff6c3f090b3ba645f64c91e95e997e.summary: Added 'subscriptions' question to onboarding flow and introduced 'exclusive' option flag. Instagram merged into TikTok label; Discord and blog/newsletter retired with legacy ID mapping. Admin tally applies read-time folding for retired IDs and write-in text classification.

364433c460916d2de22bf35956dfa0f9f5e8edff.title: Add minimal to REASONINGEFFORTS and update model effort docs
364433c460916d2de22bf35956dfa0f9f5e8edff.summary: Added 'minimal' to the REASONING_EFFORTS array in `common/src/constants/reasoning-effort.ts`. Updated documentation in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to clarify that `efforts` must contain native provider settings, not aliases. Removed obsolete comments about DeepSeek/MiMo collapsing `medium` to `high`, now specifying V4 Flash supports low/high/max and V4 Pro supports high/max. The `defaultEffort` field is explicitly separated from `reasoningEffort` to allow distinct picker defaults.

84f4ca34cd7481a4d5bc577ebf5d7343b385650a.title: CLI ad and referral banners use INVERTEDCTAFG and static widths
84f4ca34cd7481a4d5bc577ebf5d7343b385650a.summary: ad-banner.tsx replaces hardcoded inverted CTA foreground logic with the INVERTED_CTA_FG constant from ui-constants. freebuff-referral-banner.tsx refactors BountyPitchLine into BountyPromoLine, enforcing static DASHBOARD_BUTTON_WIDTH to prevent keyboard focus markers from shifting adjacent actions. The promo deadline remains visible locally, while the standing bounty pitch is removed to reduce redundancy with the picker and Earn page. Layout logic now explicitly handles menu width constraints where model and referral actions previously collided.

5f8f4c0129f21df6161929ca0031ce67b2ccd141.title: CLI package bumped to 0.0.145
5f8f4c0129f21df6161929ca0031ce67b2ccd141.summary: CLI release package version updated from 0.0.143 to 0.0.145 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Scope limited to CLI packaging metadata. No functional code changes.

b615f928ac3c3d888c5e82b21fdd768e8d7e941e.title: Bump freebuff CLI version to 0.0.143
b615f928ac3c3d888c5e82b21fdd768e8d7e941e.summary: Package version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json incremented from 0.0.142 to 0.0.143. Reflects routine release cycle. No functional code changes.

3a66664e54bc6ebb3dcc9dd073e45769a85d045f.title: CLI: OpenTUI musl native bundle support
3a66664e54bc6ebb3dcc9dd073e45769a85d045f.summary: Added `libc` option to `OpenTuiNativeTarget` and updated `getOpenTuiNativePackageName` to append `-musl` suffix for musl builds. `build-binary.ts` imports the new type to ensure all native packages required by `bun build --compile` static analysis resolve correctly, specifically for Linux targets where 0.3.4 introduced musl variants. This prevents build failures caused by missing optional native modules during compilation.

b9810f1556b1ad235441f5bea1278b948d119973.title: Add freebuff-signup-block.ts with SignupBlockReason type and
b9810f1556b1ad235441f5bea1278b948d119973.summary: New file `common/src/constants/freebuff-signup-block.ts` exports `SignupBlockReason` type, `SIGNUP_BLOCK_MESSAGES` record, and `isSignupBlockReason` type guard. Placed in `common` to avoid pulling `db`, `stripe`, and server env schema into the browser bundle via the auth barrel. Covers five refusal reasons: `mailbox_already_registered`, `privacy_egress`, `untrusted_client_ip`, `ip_signup_velocity`, `prefix_signup_velocity`. `isSignupBlockReason` narrows untrusted `?error=` query-string values without a cast at call sites.

44212cc2816aedc01e2239edb193a18909727871.title: CLI shows provider usage error instead of credit prompt
44212cc2816aedc01e2239edb193a18909727871.summary: CLI intercepts HTTP 402 and provider billing wording via `isFreebuffProviderUsageError` in `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`. Prevents free users from seeing Codebuff credit-purchase flow when upstream providers like CrofAI or OpenRouter run out of quota. Shared message and regex defined in new `common/src/constants/freebuff-errors.ts`.

a5b6b0cf4ef9fbf7f6cf529e803601f243cd1b0f.title: Raise project creation limits and clarify concurrency cap
a5b6b0cf4ef9fbf7f6cf529e803601f243cd1b0f.summary: Increased `FREEBUFF_WEB_LIMITED_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT` and `FREEBUFF_CLOUD_BLANK_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT` from 3 and 5 to 10. This prevents outer-region users from hitting the creation cap due to transient failures in the project bootstrap ladder (warm pool, cold Daytona, browser runtime), as failed creations no longer consume quota. `FREEBUFF_MAX_CONCURRENT_PROJECTS` remains explicitly capped at 1 to avoid `session_superseded` errors on the current single-session web store, pending multi-session infrastructure parity with Desktop.

90ca26c0745bcbbcd40ea7ac385c031977d328cc.title: Add Cloudflare Worker egress detection with edge corroboration
90ca26c0745bcbbcd40ea7ac385c031977d328cc.summary: New `cf-worker` detector in `common/src/constants/cf-worker-signals.ts` identifies requests originating from Cloudflare Workers, targeting token-pooling proxies. Detection requires a valid `cf-ray` header to confirm the request traversed our edge, preventing caller-authored header forgery. The logic includes an allowlist for internal Worker zones and captures detailed evidence for ban review dashboards. This mechanism replaces previous client-side fingerprinting methods that suffered from high false-positive rates.

c235ded0aec8696b8af0e9fbb9e7fe1529e8bf1f.title: Click queue preview to expand panel
c235ded0aec8696b8af0e9fbb9e7fe1529e8bf1f.summary: Queue preview in `chat-input-bar.tsx` now supports mouse clicks to expand `queue-panel.tsx`. New `clickable-title-box.tsx` component intercepts top-border clicks. `use-queue-ui.ts` updates hint text to "click to expand" when width >= 80. Scope: CLI chat components and queue UI hooks.

a6f9f6f9f36afe33900b80d4df2d61d646a8460f.title: onUsageIncomplete callback surfaces missing provider usage receipts
a6f9f6f9f36afe33900b80d4df2d61d646a8460f.summary: SDK `promptAiSdkStream` now reports usage exactly once via `reportUsage`, falling back to `onUsageIncomplete` when a stream ends before a provider receipt arrives. Root cause: streams terminating without final usage data left cost and token accounting silently incomplete. Propagated through `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`, and `sdk/src/run.ts`. `CacheDebugUsageData` gains optional `reasoningOutputTokens` sourced from `outputTokenDetails.reasoningTokens`; `run.ts` wraps signal callbacks in try/catch to prevent handler throws from aborting the run.

df64ef498a3fb6d30d36e94869a65e2fed60f6f5.title: SDK bumps AI to v7, requires Node 22, updates JSON types
df64ef498a3fb6d30d36e94869a65e2fed60f6f5.summary: SDK and agent-runtime dependencies updated to `ai` ^7.0.59, replacing v5. Node engine requirement raised to >=22.0.0 in sdk/package.json. JSON types (`JSONObject`, `ProviderMetadata`) allow `undefined` values, with corresponding Zod schema and utility function updates in `common` and `agents`. Build script adds CJS shim for `ai` package; `undici` added to SDK deps.

c26a74d54c7b2ff0429b410b0109aa0115f29c6f.title: Referral banner promo copy shortened
c26a74d54c7b2ff0429b410b0109aa0115f29c6f.summary: BountyPitchLine in cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx drops 'up to' and 'sessions' from the promo line. New copy reads 'earn a bounty, spend up to {promo.dailySessions} a day'. End date moved to trailing muted span. Affects CLI banner only.

389f40a9a9a113232c22a5e93ee40d01a4ee7b08.title: Windows bash detection moved to dedicated module
389f40a9a9a113232c22a5e93ee40d01a4ee7b08.summary: Windows bash discovery extracted into new `sdk/src/tools/windows-bash.ts`, centralizing logic for `run_terminal_command` and Desktop surfaces. Fixes false negatives for per-user Git installs and non-C: drives by deriving paths from env vars instead of hardcoded literals. Explicitly excludes WSL launcher paths to prevent cryptic failures when no distro is present.

58e2564ab07e029b066e81765e85b4be189b303e.title: Remove x-ai/grok models from AgentDefinition
58e2564ab07e029b066e81765e85b4be189b303e.summary: Removes `x-ai/grok-4-fast`, `x-ai/grok-4.1-fast`, and `x-ai/grok-code-fast-1` from the `ModelName` union type in `agents/types/agent-definition.ts` and the corresponding template types. Updates the default model in `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/my-custom-agent.ts` to `anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5`. This change ensures type safety by eliminating references to deprecated or unsupported Grok models within the agent definition schema.

00e5fa83a7e86d744e826cef0021ee41b4ccce17.title: SDK adds onUsage and onCompaction run options
00e5fa83a7e86d744e826cef0021ee41b4ccce17.summary: `RunOptions` gains `onUsage` and `onCompaction` callbacks for provider usage and context compaction events. Runtime attributes usage per agent via `AgentUsageData` and reports compaction triggers from `compact-history.ts`. Covers SDK, agent-runtime, and shared contracts. `onUsage` fires per model request; `onCompaction` fires root-agent compactions with trigger and threshold.

44177dad55f47ee36c17c8c98b60c95202fa9ab1.title: Unify session gate codes in shared types
44177dad55f47ee36c17c8c98b60c95202fa9ab1.summary: Shared `FREEBUFF_GATE_CODES` constant replaces duplicated CLI gate logic, defining wire contract for `/api/v1/chat/completions` rejections. `getFreebuffGateCode` helper enforces exact `error`/`statusCode` pair matching via `Object.hasOwn` to prevent prototype pollution false positives. CLI `FreebuffGateErrorKind` now excludes `session_limit_reached` (Desktop-only concurrent tab cap) and imports types from `common`. `endsTheSession` flag distinguishes fatal session loss from transient refusals like `waiting_room_queued`.

837519d09bdafee951022bd77b63e5cfc25ecc7e.title: GLM 5.2 promo surfaces and entitlement breakdown
837519d09bdafee951022bd77b63e5cfc25ecc7e.summary: Added `FreebuffGlmPromo` type and `getGlmPromo` accessor to `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` to share promo data across surfaces. `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` now renders a promo line with daily session limits and end date, plus a `DashboardButton` using `safeOpen`. `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` passes the promo block to the banner. The `promo` field in `FreebuffSessionEntitlementBreakdown` is optional, ensuring older clients still calculate `limit` correctly via the server's total.

7ca8fa441715fb750cbaac2bb834a4b544c42313.title: docs: budgeted hooks and failure reporting
7ca8fa441715fb750cbaac2bb834a4b544c42313.summary: docs/testing.md adds hook timeout budgets for fixture-heavy tests. CI now logs specific failing test names to avoid buried output. Covers `test/support/budgets.ts` and `scripts/ci/bun-test-failures.ts`. `FIXTURE_HOOK_MS` replaces default 5s for `makeDb`/`makeRepo`/`makeEngine` hooks to prevent false positives on stalled runners.

702b43bf6fbd41be7405bc3e02773f21a7888d37.title: CLIHARNESS constant gates base2 vs base3 harness
702b43bf6fbd41be7405bc3e02773f21a7888d37.summary: New `CLI_HARNESS` constant in `cli/src/utils/constants.ts` defaults to `base2` for `DEFAULT` and `LITE` modes, reverting from `base3` due to inferior completion rates on free-tier models. `cli/src/utils/freebuff-agent-selection.ts` now resolves agent IDs dynamically based on this flag rather than hardcoding base3 roots. Added `agents/base2-free-deepseek-flash-evals.ts`, `agents/base3-free-deepseek-flash-evals.ts`, and `evals/buffbench/main-flash-harness.ts` to support paired A/B testing. MAX and PLAN modes remain unaffected by this switch.

db9b6fc11799d1756d2b434b432c8da1f6422046.title: Add base3 CLI roots for free models and evals
db9b6fc11799d1756d2b434b432c8da1f6422046.summary: New `agents/base3-free-*.ts` files instantiate `createBase3CliRoot` for DeepSeek, Fable, GLM, Luna, MiMo, and MiniMax. `base3.ts` exports `createBase3CliRoot` to separate CLI product surface from the core harness, preventing Desktop tool inheritance issues. `base3-evals.ts` and `base3-lite.ts` are added; Luna drops `reasoningOptions` to respect catalog effort controls. Fable is CLI-only, sharing IDs with Web roots where applicable.

da1f340a36ff033086086da3fe1411e796af2bc3.title: Shared reasoning effort ladder and clamping
da1f340a36ff033086086da3fe1411e796af2bc3.summary: New `reasoning-effort.ts` defines a shared, ordered ladder (`low` through `ultra`) and `clampReasoningEffort` logic, replacing Desktop-only definitions to unify `ModelOption.efforts` across surfaces. `freebuff-models.ts` adds `efforts` and `defaultEffort` fields to `FreebuffModelOption`, enabling per-model user pickers that strictly limit spending to existing API ceilings. DeepSeek models use a prompt-level dial (`FREEBUFF_PROMPT_EFFORT_MODEL_IDS`) where `medium` remains byte-identical to current requests, while `clampReasoningEffort` ensures rerouted requests land on the highest allowed rung below the user's request.

119af4afe0f2529ce76714ac740c1db1cb8940fc.title: Remove Poolside Laguna S 2.1 god-mode models
119af4afe0f2529ce76714ac740c1db1cb8940fc.summary: Deletes `poolside/laguna-s-2.1` and `openrouter/poolside/laguna-s-2.1` from `FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODELS`. Removes associated constants, agent IDs, and mode sets from `free-agents.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts`. Scope limited to shared core constants; no CLI/Web surface changes beyond constant removal. `KIMI_K3_ECO_MODEL` remains in god-mode list.

97ea5981ff9943999d24543fa28dd5cc6fe5654a.title: Add progress field to FreebuffStreakLine interface
97ea5981ff9943999d24543fa28dd5cc6fe5654a.summary: Added `progress: { filled, total, beyond }` to `FreebuffStreakLine` in `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts`. This provides raw counts alongside the glyph string for surfaces that render custom CSS circles instead of text dots. The `total` field hardcodes `FREEBUFF_STREAK_WEEK` to ensure external renderers know the slot count without importing constants.

e39fb73424f48f7861215b6d67b095c21885f9ee.title: Muse Spark reasoning effort set to xhigh, enum widened to provider
e39fb73424f48f7861215b6d67b095c21885f9ee.summary: FREEBUFF_MUSE_SPARK_REASONING_EFFORT in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts switches from high to xhigh, and the FreebuffModelOption.reasoningEffort type widens from low/medium/high to minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh to match Meta's provider scale. The change reflects live measurements on Muse Spark: xhigh buys ~8% more reasoning tokens than high at ~26% higher latency, while minimal cuts reasoning 2.4x with no observed accuracy loss on tested samples. The wider enum lives on the model row rather than agent-definition.ts so one provider's extra rung does not leak into values every published agent can declare. Scope is shared core constants only; no CLI picker, Web/Desktop, or docs files carry the change.

caba427c7fed797dd58e2cd6cc5a22232a5eeaea.title: Pin Muse Spark reasoning effort to high
caba427c7fed797dd58e2cd6cc5a22232a5eeaea.summary: Added FREEBUFF_MUSE_SPARK_REASONING_EFFORT constant set to 'high' and wired it to MUSE_SPARK_12_CONTRIBUTOR_MODEL. Updated getFreebuffModelReasoningEffort to check FREEBUFF_WEB_ALL_MODELS as a fallback alongside SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS. This ensures Web-only models like Muse Spark correctly resolve their reasoning effort, which previously failed due to the CLI/Desktop catalog exclusion.

9ddaa67d28223f14873db3c78e8fd0fbf98608c1.title: Recalibrate database cost regression thresholds to measured noise
9ddaa67d28223f14873db3c78e8fd0fbf98608c1.summary: Regression thresholds in `common/src/util/database-request-cost.ts` widened (`regressionRatio` 1.5→2.0, floors 20→150ms, 2→8 trips) and p50 excluded from paging. Previous settings paged on ordinary traffic within a day of shipping (e.g., 9ms→20ms wall, 2→5 round trips). Floors now scale per-lane via `REGRESSION_FLOOR_BUDGET_SHARE` (0.375) to prevent light lanes from being unpageable, while heavy lanes retain global floors. Budgets remain non-paging pending weekly validation.

baaa1bb3570337a95a6fdc526ef83963dd67bde6.title: Drop knowledge.md from knowledge-file priority list
baaa1bb3570337a95a6fdc526ef83963dd67bde6.summary: Removed `knowledge.md` from `KNOWLEDGE_FILE_NAMES` and deleted the `PRIMARY_KNOWLEDGE_FILE_NAME` export in `common/src/constants/knowledge.ts`. `isKnowledgeFile` now matches only `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` (case-insensitive) plus `*.knowledge.md`. `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts` updates the project instructions prompt to reference generic fenced blocks instead of `knowledge.md`. Scope covers Shared/Core constants, Agent Runtime templates, and SDK docs.

fe7b8fad52fa2ea67a8d2cbb86638e7e0cbb7cf8.title: CLI launcher detects Windows startup crashes and tees stderr
fe7b8fad52fa2ea67a8d2cbb86638e7e0cbb7cf8.summary: Launcher now identifies Windows startup crashes as CPU feature failures (missing AVX2) via exit code 0xC0000409 within a 10s window, triggering baseline fallback. It tees stderr on Windows to capture the last 8KB of output for crash reports, sanitizing terminal control sequences before replay. System info now accurately reports AVX2 status based on cached crashes rather than optimistic defaults. Updates are skipped if the binary has already exited to prevent race conditions with the baseline relaunch.

1b28a1b851243771ec6e1433673df5e676496f9c.title: base3 single-loop harness roots and file-read windowing
1b28a1b851243771ec6e1433673df5e676496f9c.summary: Adds `FREEBUFF_WEB_BASE3_AGENT_ID_BY_MODEL` and `base3-free-*` root ids in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` for the Web/Cloud base3 single-loop harness (no subagents, no reviewer, mechanical compaction). `common/src/util/file-read-limits.ts` adds `fileReadWindowsOf` and `applyFileReadWindows` so `windowedFileReads` agents forward per-file line windows; windows must be applied before `createFileReadLimiter` or offsets past the budget's truncation point falsely report "beyond the end of the file". `sdk/src/run.ts` now forwards `fileWindows` to `read_files` overrides instead of applying them locally, matching the SDK's local-reader ordering. `gravitySurface` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/gravity-index.ts` matches both `base2-free*` and `base3-free*` prefixes so base3 roots aren't misattributed to `codebuff_cli`.

68b34fa74dd1efa2451b9a4a6df7f5a15ba2a2b3.title: Remove knowledge.md, update prompt injection
68b34fa74dd1efa2451b9a4a6df7f5a15ba2a2b3.summary: Removed `knowledge.md` support from `KNOWLEDGE_FILE_NAMES`, prioritizing `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`. `base3.ts` now injects formatted knowledge blocks via `PLACEHOLDER.KNOWLEDGE_FILES_CONTENTS`. `strings.ts` wraps content in labeled fences with explicit session instructions. `init.ts` and `run-state.ts` updated to reflect new priority order and constant usage.

85fe163fd7843afe7dc3d07df57d2ac8eade07c4.title: Add Kimi K3 Eco, remove HY3, Ling 3.0 Flash, Greg 2
85fe163fd7843afe7dc3d07df57d2ac8eade07c4.summary: Kimi K3 Eco (`base2-free-kimi-k3-eco`) added to free agents and model configs. HY3, Ling 3.0 Flash, and Greg 2 Ultra/Super removed on 2026-08-07. HY3 fully deleted from `model-config.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts` including paid/BYOK fallbacks and Atlas Cloud adapter. Ling/Greg were god-only test rows with no shipped client exposure.

4f80bdb45dcca5ab6c33304482b9699356711a0e.title: Clarify foreign-client-signals sampling bias and enforcement rationale
4f80bdb45dcca5ab6c33304482b9699356711a0e.summary: Comments in common/src/constants/foreign-client-signals.ts corrected to explain why the initial 18-user hand-sample is not representative evidence for enforcing the no-tools signal. The 30-day backtest showed 90% of flagged accounts perform real agentic work, confirming the signal remains report-only. This change affects only internal documentation and detection logic comments in Shared/Core.

0bbfdeb6b0c850151bbedd015b31cd6c99f9e2a8.title: Add stepPrompt to researcher agents
0bbfdeb6b0c850151bbedd015b31cd6c99f9e2a8.summary: Added `stepPrompt` to `researcher-docs.ts` and `researcher-web.ts`. This fixes a bug where steps ending on tool results caused the model to stop after thinking, returning no answer. The prompt explicitly instructs the model to continue with tool calls or a final answer.

968c6682de8ea3e75d3dbbad2c6591fe28176920.title: Add deterministic verdict file to terminal broker smoke test
968c6682de8ea3e75d3dbbad2c6591fe28176920.summary: The `createConsoleReaderScript` function in `cli/src/smoke/terminal-command-broker.ts` now accepts a `verdictPath` argument to write a completion marker after the CONIN$ probe resolves. This replaces a fixed `Bun.sleep(250)` wait with a `waitFor` check on the verdict file, preventing race conditions with PowerShell startup and ensuring stdout is flushed before the broker force-kills the process on Windows.

ab5e182182a84b9df51cc00e8cdf96ce75d4bc0f.title: Recalibrate database request cost budgets to measured production
ab5e182182a84b9df51cc00e8cdf96ce75d4bc0f.summary: Updated `DATABASE_REQUEST_BUDGETS` in `common/src/util/database-request-cost.ts` to reflect post-private-endpoint traffic (~11.8ms/round-trip) rather than aspirational server-execution targets. Split `ancillary` into `light` and `ancillary` lanes to expose fast paths (e.g., `streak_get`, `cli_auth_status`) previously masked by wide budgets. Budgets now serve as a no-regression ratchet; absolute breaches remain reported-only until a full week of clean data validates them for paging.

7a29686a3dc1313a85ce61f22d76bc18a78de3f5.title: Shared CLI auth code lifetime constant
7a29686a3dc1313a85ce61f22d76bc18a78de3f5.summary: Added `common/src/constants/auth.ts` exporting `CLI_AUTH_CODE_LIFETIME_MS` (1 hour). Unifies device-code expiration logic across CLI (codebuff.com) and Desktop (freebuff.com) surfaces. Prevents drift where one app times out earlier than the other due to hardcoded values. Clients use `expiresInMs` from API responses to avoid clock-skew bugs when validating `expiresAt`.

2d6439de4640f2f4642e07c1f8decad1cdb00812.title: Extract model availability notice to shared util
2d6439de4640f2f4642e07c1f8decad1cdb00812.summary: Moved `getFreebuffModelAvailabilityNotice`, `formatFreebuffCountryName`, and `formatFreebuffPrivacySignalList` from `cli/src/components/freebuff-landing-screen.tsx` to new `common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts`. This unifies the reduced-catalog explanation text across CLI and Desktop surfaces to prevent UI drift. The shared utility handles country code resolution via `Intl.DisplayNames` with raw-code fallback for missing ICU data.

e1129d9e5842529779d9d8098b3d0b0efe715045.title: Add utcDateKey helper to reddit-capi-events
e1129d9e5842529779d9d8098b3d0b0efe715045.summary: Adds `utcDateKey` to `common/src/util/reddit-capi-events.ts` to standardize UTC day boundaries for D1/D7/D24 retention eligibility. This prevents lost conversions caused by memoization mismatches where local timezones (e.g., Pacific) lag behind UTC rollovers. The helper is isolated in a dependency-free module to avoid importing the database connection pool from `packages/internal/src/reddit-conversions.ts`.

660747443d071feffcc7ccb584ac2977e631e0dc.title: Add desktop.loginfailed analytics event
660747443d071feffcc7ccb584ac2977e631e0dc.summary: Added `DESKTOP_LOGIN_FAILED` to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts` to capture client-side device-code sign-in failures. Included in `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` in `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts` to bypass 1% sampling. Necessary because `/api/auth/cli/code` returns 200 for unreachable hosts, TLS interception, clock skew, and abandoned codes, making failures invisible to the server otherwise.

bb7dbadf40439cd9a5159185a4d1a242b68f74ac.title: Add rootagentnotools signal to foreign client detection
bb7dbadf40439cd9a5159185a4d1a242b68f74ac.summary: detectForeignClientSignal now checks for root agents offering no tools, classifying them as bare completion endpoints via the new root_agent_no_tools signal. This addition stems from observed non-coding automations using Freebuff root agent IDs without toolsets, though enforcement is disabled due to high false positives in mixed agentic traffic. The change affects common/src/constants/foreign-client-signals.ts, updating the ForeignClientSignal union and detection logic. Signals like sampling_params are reclassified to exclude root agents, preserving them as measurements to support future account-level rule building.

68d9a88c81cfd8b1b1de979ca99eb3468290f961.title: Foreign client detection switches to exclusion-based signature
68d9a88c81cfd8b1b1de979ca99eb3468290f961.summary: Signature derivation now filters `toolNames` against a new `GENERIC_TOOL_NAMES` exclusion list, automatically including non-generic tools. This fixes false positives where `researcher-web` was flagged due to a hand-picked signature omitting `web_search` and `read_url`. The change is localized to `common/src/constants/foreign-client-signals.ts`. The `ForeignClientDowngradeMode` enum and `mode` parameter are removed; `foreign_toolset` signals now unconditionally trigger downgrades.

8d95d803aedf841503be0f60718ed8374e492b5c.title: Add savings CTA analytics event
8d95d803aedf841503be0f60718ed8374e492b5c.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_HOME_SAVINGS_CTA_CLICKED` to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Fires alongside `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_DOWNLOAD_CLICKED` with `savings`, `perSeat`, `seats`, `tools`, and `toolCount` properties. Enables bucketing click-through by computed savings value.

d800f61ca0291aa9270a75e454fb1a4a8ce09712.title: Split database cost breach into regression and over-budget
d800f61ca0291aa9270a75e454fb1a4a8ce09712.summary: DatabaseCostVerdict now exposes separate `overBudget` and `regressed` arrays, replacing the single `reasons` blob for actionable triage. `breach` strictly tracks regressions against the baseline, because absolute budgets became universally exceeded, causing alert fatigue and masking genuine 10x regressions. Affects `common/src/util/database-request-cost.ts`. `evaluateFamily` returns distinct arrays, and `reasons` merges them with regressions prioritized.

070db75b0429851b103a870004b5029c4cd5700e.title: suggestfollowups prompts shift to goal-oriented phrasing
070db75b0429851b103a870004b5029c4cd5700e.summary: The suggest_followups tool now enforces short, goal-oriented prompt generation across base-chat, base2, and base-deep agents. This change updates the tool description, parameter schema, and type definitions to explicitly exclude implementation steps, file paths, and manual user chores from suggested followups. The modification affects agents/types/tools.ts, common/src/tools/params/tool/suggest-followups.ts, and related agent templates. Followup prompts must now name the desired outcome in one sentence, allowing the agent to determine the execution strategy.

4e79ce476b22c73f06a2ca9fe5210d83d1c325ed.title: Add base3 agent with windowed reads and context compaction
4e79ce476b22c73f06a2ca9fe5210d83d1c325ed.summary: New `base3` agent definition introduces `windowedFileReads` and `compactContext` flags, defaulting to false to preserve legacy behavior. `read_files` now accepts `{ path, offset, limit }` entries, while `glob` adds `max_results` to cap output. The runtime implements mechanical history summarization via `packages/agent-runtime/src/compact-history.ts`, triggered by context limits or cold prompt caches. Tool descriptions for `code_search` and `read_files` updated to encourage a search-first workflow when windowed reads are enabled.

87acd39098734f870266915e02267851c4cd4a4f.title: foreign-client detection downgrades free-mode requests to
87acd39098734f870266915e02267851c4cd4a4f.summary: Adds `foreign-client-signals.ts` to detect and downgrade free-mode requests not originating from Freebuff clients. Uses tool-schema signatures and sampling-param heuristics to identify foreign traffic, routing it to `inclusionai/ling-3.0-tiny:free` to protect inference budget. Covers core constants and detection logic; enforces via `enforce-toolset` or `enforce` modes, with log-flood protection via 64-char tool name truncation.

1358346295e7e4fcd7b2bd3d4fa93b268518b28d.title: Add bookmark gate analytics events
1358346295e7e4fcd7b2bd3d4fa93b268518b28d.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_BOOKMARK_GATE_SHOWN` and `FREEBUFF_BOOKMARK_GATE_CONFIRMED` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum. Tracks blocking bookmark prompt after first prompt in Web/Cloud workspaces. Enables measuring abandon rate via event delta. Scope: `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`.

2bc664c5bd3c5ed730de2a5af880493d2c5d672c.title: base3 agent id suffix splits desktop thread metrics
2bc664c5bd3c5ed730de2a5af880493d2c5d672c.summary: Adds `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_THREAD_V3_SUFFIX` ('v3') and optional `agentGeneration` param to `getFreebuffDesktopThreadAgentId`. Base3 desktop threads now get distinct agent IDs (`freebuff-desktop-thread-{local|worktree}-v3`) to split spend/run counts by `agent_id` in DB during staggered base2/base3 rollout. Updates `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_THREAD_AGENT_IDS` and `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` to register the new base3 IDs against `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_MODELS`.

92a6961b894204c5620f9dd77cd2606e54b9a397.title: Fix CLI suggestion lag and add skill model invocation control
92a6961b894204c5620f9dd77cd2606e54b9a397.summary: Removed `useDeferredValue` from the CLI suggestion engine to prevent input desync during heavy renders. Added `disable-model-invocation` frontmatter support to skills, filtering them out of model discovery in `agent-runtime` while keeping them available for explicit user commands. `createSkillDefinition` now centralizes skill object construction across SDK and runtime.

accfa422f66916c360186c12c240d9279acaf396.title: Unify followup style guidance across agents
accfa422f66916c360186c12c240d9279acaf396.summary: Extracted duplicated prompt instructions into a shared `FOLLOWUP_STYLE_GUIDANCE` constant in `agents/constants.ts`. `base-deep.ts` and `base2.ts` now import this constant instead of embedding inconsistent inline text. The `suggest-followups.ts` tool description was updated to clarify that suggestions must be actionable by the agent, removing the 'manual work' prohibition in favor of tool-aware judgment.

787e80a8f1456623d2b0605c9f282165ac72dcb7.title: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.142
787e80a8f1456623d2b0605c9f282165ac72dcb7.summary: freebuff/cli/release/package.json version updated from 0.0.141 to 0.0.142. Release packaging metadata change. No functional code modified.

0f112dfc17a5d2dfc4419d5c4471a7cb8b49276c.title: Terminal broker failure telemetry
0f112dfc17a5d2dfc4419d5c4471a7cb8b49276c.summary: Added `TERMINAL_BROKER_SPAWN_FAILED` analytics event and `classifyTerminalBrokerFailure` to `terminal-command-broker.ts`. Telemetry fires only on Windows in interactive parent, loading analytics lazily to avoid detached broker side effects. Event added to `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` in `analytics-sampling.ts` to prevent sampling distortion for rare regressions. Includes `sanitizeTerminalBrokerVersion` to validate version strings before reporting.

25d69d5854023aae6361a9dbe09ab23090638563.title: Muse Spark 1.2 tagline switches to Queue with fallback tooltip
25d69d5854023aae6361a9dbe09ab23090638563.summary: Muse Spark 1.2 picker tagline changes from '1M context' to 'Queue', backed by new `taglineTooltip` field in `FreebuffModelOption`. Tooltip cites `MUSE_SPARK_FALLBACK_NOTICE`, explaining requests reroute to GPT-5.6 Luna after 10s (`MUSE_SPARK_FALLBACK_AFTER_MS`) rather than waiting on upstream 60s `Retry-After`. `isNew` badge removed from `MUSE_SPARK_12_CONTRIBUTOR_MODEL`.

851f10f5262ed0de613c360e7724ff58e450f0ad.title: Fix limited-tier GLM selection
851f10f5262ed0de613c360e7724ff58e450f0ad.summary: freebuffCliOfferedModelIds now includes FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_MODEL_ID for all access tiers. selectionIsValid logic drops the accessTier === 'full' check, relying only on weeklySessionsRemaining. Fixes limited-tier users' GLM picks silently swapping to recommended models due to bounty grants being redeemable at limited access.

f392d93770b49c7399c49afd550a4d2783c37afd.title: Bump freebuff CLI package to v0.0.141
f392d93770b49c7399c49afd550a4d2783c37afd.summary: Version bumped from 0.0.140 to 0.0.141 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Routine release preparation for the CLI package.

e455a7f11d4caa461b258678a9a3bb975da44860.title: Terminal command broker uses temp file protocol on Windows
e455a7f11d4caa461b258678a9a3bb975da44860.summary: Terminal command broker switches from custom stdio pipes to a constrained one-shot file in the OS temp directory for protocol communication. This avoids Bun's unreliable Windows `node:net` handshake failures which previously terminated the CLI as unhandled rejections. The change affects `cli/src/utils/terminal-command-broker.ts` and `docs/agents-and-tools.md`, adding `CODEBUFF_TERMINAL_COMMAND_BROKER_PROTOCOL` env var support and robust cleanup handling for Windows antivirus/indexer locks. Smoke tests now verify repeated broker spawns (64 iterations) to catch failures appearing only after multiple agent commands.

8553a9efe9d42dc01079c1f7a63907ea55ec77d0.title: CLI: Bump OpenTUI to 0.3.4, add native bundle recovery
8553a9efe9d42dc01079c1f7a63907ea55ec77d0.summary: OpenTUI core and react packages upgrade from 0.2.2 to 0.3.4 in cli/package.json. New script cli/scripts/open-tui-native-bundle.ts manages native binary installation with atomic staging and recovery to prevent monorepo hoisting. build-binary.ts replaces inline patching with prepareOpenTuiNativeBundle, ensuring stale split installs fail early.

6110b0bbfbe668dffcf4d5fe86ce8147293bf73a.title: Remove meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor context window
6110b0bbfbe668dffcf4d5fe86ce8147293bf73a.summary: Removed 'meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor' entry from CONTEXT_WINDOWS in agents/base-chat.ts. Model fallbacks to DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW for token budgeting. Affects agents subsystem context window resolution.

95f7ba2869aed9e0bd0ef259d86becf75a4ac23e.title: Add database request cost budgets and evaluation
95f7ba2869aed9e0bd0ef259d86becf75a4ac23e.summary: New `common/src/util/database-request-cost.ts` defines canonical APL for scheduled alerts and admin dashboards. Introduces `DATABASE_REQUEST_BUDGETS` with percentile limits for client SQL wall time and round trips across web and freebuff-web services. Provides `evaluateDatabaseRequestCosts` to detect regressions against baselines using configurable thresholds. Covers core shared utilities only.

27caf8248eaf3be6e303a93b58e27529e2008630.title: Muse Spark 1.2 context window added to base-chat
27caf8248eaf3be6e303a93b58e27529e2008630.summary: Added 'meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor' with a 1_000_000 token context window to CONTEXT_WINDOWS in agents/base-chat.ts. Prevents fallback to DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW for this model. Scope limited to agents subsystem.

6059b884a999ffb281a0c15913c659f9bc6f5308.title: CLI takeover retry logic and OpenRouter attribution headers
6059b884a999ffb281a0c15913c659f9bc6f5308.summary: Takeover prompt now allows manual retries on timeout or unknown outcomes, removing the restart-to-check requirement. `classifyFreebuffSessionRequestFailure` expanded to treat 408, 429, and 503 as safe to retry since they occur before mutation commits. OpenRouter attribution constants received comments clarifying `HTTP-Referer` requirements and category caps. `README.md` added local dev prerequisites for Docker and `.env.local`.

3a8cc3135b1201b6403abb26762a309b269c8119.title: CLI session failure state carries retry timing and outcomeUnknown
3a8cc3135b1201b6403abb26762a309b269c8119.summary: The CLI's session state replaces the plain `error` string with a structured `FreebuffSessionFailure` type carrying `retry` timing and an `outcomeUnknown` flag. This distinguishes safe retries from potentially committed mutating requests, preventing duplicate takeover actions when the server may have processed a request before the client timed out. The `TakeoverPrompt` component now renders specific messages for 503, timeout, and unknown-outcome failures, with a countdown to the next retry. `classifyFreebuffSessionRequestFailure` encodes the policy: POST requests without a response are marked `outcomeUnknown` unless the server returns a documented 503 `service_overloaded`, while GET requests retry on 408, 429, and 5xx.

fbf092f424327cab5a5086a0cf209d9199dcac73.title: Add reasoningEffort to model catalog and CLI picker
fbf092f424327cab5a5086a0cf209d9199dcac73.summary: Adds optional `reasoningEffort` field to `FreebuffModelOption` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and renders it as a suffix in the CLI model selector (`cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`). This ensures the displayed reasoning level matches the value the server sends via `applyFreebuffReasoningDefaults`, preventing drift between UI and actual model behavior. The field is omitted for models without effort levels or where provider defaults should remain untouched, with specific constraints for DeepSeek and MiMo adapters that collapse values below `max`.

405bf49baa05e2abf854e5c051b36ad54a35002f.title: Windows terminal watchdog health reporting and launch log shipping
405bf49baa05e2abf854e5c051b36ad54a35002f.summary: Added `windows-terminal-health.ts` to centralize failure reporting for terminal broker and watchdog spawn issues. On Windows, `index.tsx` now calls `drainClientLogs()` immediately at startup to ensure a launch row exists before the watchdog arms, mitigating data loss if endpoint security terminates the process. `CODEBUFF_ENABLE_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` is removed from `env.ts` and `smoke-terminal-broker-windows.ts`; `CODEBUFF_NO_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` remains the sole opt-out for EDR/AV conflicts. Analytics initialization in `analytics.ts` now supports dependency injection for `enqueueClientLog` and tracks initialization state.

175191e4366e34542cfe2d7dfdd9162faf7c2361.title: Remove Freebuff Enterprise row from README
175191e4366e34542cfe2d7dfdd9162faf7c2361.summary: Removed the Freebuff Enterprise row from the product table in README.md and README.zh-CN.md. This change updates the public documentation to reflect the current product lineup. The Enterprise offering is no longer listed alongside Web, Cloud, and Chat.

52804281c6e03e0c74bbd7eb6b9965d369a5cf15.title: Muse Spark 1.2 context window set to 1M
52804281c6e03e0c74bbd7eb6b9965d369a5cf15.summary: Context window for meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor set to 1,000,000 tokens in agents/base-chat.ts. Prevents default 52k budget cap on million-token models. Internal config change affecting token budget calculation.

55258aabc4592ed2e90fc5d99fd7ae1e8a7bf10b.title: CODEBUFFENABLETERMINALWATCHDOG opt-in for Windows
55258aabc4592ed2e90fc5d99fd7ae1e8a7bf10b.summary: Added `CODEBUFF_ENABLE_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` env var to explicitly opt into the PowerShell terminal watchdog on Windows. The watchdog now defaults to disabled on Windows because the bootstrap process shape (hidden grandchild shell) trips EDR/AV heuristics. `CODEBUFF_NO_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` remains as a backwards-compatible suppression flag. Changes span `cli/src/types/env.ts`, `cli/src/utils/env.ts`, `cli/src/utils/terminal-watchdog.ts`, and the Windows smoke test script.

a6571b01b1383c6806b1344375d38525846701ac.title: Freebuff Cloud GA and Enterprise landing analytics
a6571b01b1383c6806b1344375d38525846701ac.summary: README tables mark Freebuff Cloud GA (drop Beta tag) and add Freebuff Enterprise row. AnalyticsEvent gains FREEBUFF_ENTERPRISE_CONTACT_SUBMITTED for /enterprise form submissions. Event carries companySize and AI lab flag for inbound demand segmentation. Covers README.md, README.zh-CN.md, and common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts.

2368b27e2d8a3b5f98f3e242083ba4a59dc0e0e2.title: CLI release package.json bumps to 0.0.140
2368b27e2d8a3b5f98f3e242083ba4a59dc0e0e2.summary: freebuff/cli/release/package.json version field updated from 0.0.138 to 0.0.140. Reflects standard release cadence. Scope limited to CLI packaging metadata.

126f792988825047c0b547dcf5f7bfb27ae9000d.title: Add OpenRouter attribution headers
126f792988825047c0b547dcf5f7bfb27ae9000d.summary: New file common/src/constants/openrouter-attribution.ts exports OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_HEADERS with HTTP-Referer, X-OpenRouter-Title, and X-OpenRouter-Categories set to Freebuff metadata. This centralizes OpenRouter API attribution for CLI and cloud agents. Scope limited to shared core constants. Headers use as const for type safety.

956dcf938814d5da8af5f2c1c1216f14d1bcd769.title: Fix GLM 5.2 limited tier allowlist
956dcf938814d5da8af5f2c1c1216f14d1bcd769.summary: GLM 5.2 now passes limited tier allowlist check in `isFreebuffWebModelAllowedForLimitedTier` via `isGlmRedeemableAtLimitedTier`. Previous logic forced GLM picks back to flash model, making bounty grants unspendable in limited regions. Covers `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and README rebranding to Codebuff.

b2a5e5362384591ac9d67ae57216ea088c5cc01d.title: Referral banner adds bounty pitch for GLM 5.2
b2a5e5362384591ac9d67ae57216ea088c5cc01d.summary: FreebuffReferralBanner in cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx now renders BountyPitchLine. This advertises EARN_URL (${LOGIN_WEBSITE_URL}/earn) as an alternative to referrals. Referrals require audience; bounties pay for self-controlled work. The URL is printed explicitly because CLI cannot open browser. Pitch appears in inline, locked, and unlocked banner variants.

c799255a7afc9de583e6fed26712c5a5ec2c48fd.title: Web default model changes to GPT-5.6 Luna
c799255a7afc9de583e6fed26712c5a5ec2c48fd.summary: DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_WEB_MODEL_ID now resolves to FREEBUFF_GPT_5_6_LUNA_MODEL_ID, replacing FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID for new Web/Cloud users. Luna is selected for superior agentic quality in long browser runs and its `dataUse: 'service'` status, eliminating AI-training notices for new accounts. The change is scoped to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, affecting Web/Cloud pickers while CLI/Desktop defaults remain on Flash. Surfaces aware of live quotas must step down to FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID when Luna's shared daily pool is exhausted to prevent admission failures.

372bcb13336cfa7eb8060b1b80208c8a9884fb9f.title: Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor added for Web-only queueing
372bcb13336cfa7eb8060b1b80208c8a9884fb9f.summary: Added Meta Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor (`meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor`) to shared constants, restricted strictly to Freebuff Web. This bypasses CLI/Desktop allowlists to enforce a Convex-side rate-limit queue, as the 60 RPM per-team cap would otherwise cause immediate 429 failures on non-Web surfaces. Changes touch `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, introducing `MUSE_SPARK_CONTRIBUTOR_RPM` and `MUSE_SPARK_RATE_LIMITED_ERROR_CODE` to map upstream 429s to queued turns. The root agent `base2-free-muse-spark` passes hierarchy gates but remains hidden from picker lists.

e93edfe8d2d61a6b285ed4e7614d50a8c9de8e29.title: CLI compact session polling, agent step buffering, llmstepnumber
e93edfe8d2d61a6b285ed4e7614d50a8c9de8e29.summary: The CLI now sends a `x-freebuff-compact-session` header on recurring active-session GET polls to omit quota snapshots, merging responses via `mergeCompactActiveSession` in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-session-api.ts` and forcing a full poll on identity mismatch. Agent steps are buffered client-side in `sdk/src/impl/database.ts` under a `MAX_AGENT_STEP_ROWS` cap and flushed on run completion, while `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` injects `llm_step_number` into metadata to distinguish LLM calls from programmatic tool calls. `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` defines the new header constant, and `common/src/constants/agents.ts` sets the row limit.

d62db1eebd81b366812817ac479860ba7ab066e9.title: README model list updates to GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31
d62db1eebd81b366812817ac479860ba7ab066e9.summary: README.md updates model descriptions to reflect the current CLI picker. Replaces generic 'best open-source' claims with specific model names like GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31. Documents DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 as the default for both full and limited modes, and adds GLM 5.2 for earned sessions.

7005d45cc1116a842069903738371fc3c64f2c92.title: Shared env-file classification and project ignore utilities
7005d45cc1116a842069903738371fc3c64f2c92.summary: New `common/src/util/env-file-path.ts` and `common/src/util/project-ignore.ts` centralize `.env` sensitivity checks and ignore-chain evaluation. `create-run-config.ts` and `read-files.tsx` now import `isSensitiveEnvFilePath` and `isEnvTemplateFilePath`, replacing local helpers. The file-tree logic delegates to `isIgnoredByIgnoreChain` and `addIgnoreFileContents`, ensuring one invalid pattern does not drop remaining valid rules. Win32 path aliases (trailing spaces/dots, NTFS streams) are stripped for env detection, while template exemptions remain exact.

7baf11ac08f12726408167fd391367d461a96249.title: Isolate integration tests in CLI, common, agent-runtime, SDK test
7baf11ac08f12726408167fd391367d461a96249.summary: Default `test` scripts in `cli`, `common`, `packages/agent-runtime`, and `sdk` now explicitly exclude `*.integration.test.ts` and `*.integration.test.tsx` files via new `test:files` helper scripts. This change prevents integration tests from running during standard unit test executions, separating them into dedicated `test:files:integration` targets. The mechanism relies on `find` commands within package.json scripts to filter file patterns before passing them to `bun test`. This applies to the CLI, Common, Agent Runtime, and SDK packages.

ba0d1c06f45f11e6259d8d3c03aee844a0b60a97.title: Clamp terminal timeoutseconds to 600s in basher agent
ba0d1c06f45f11e6259d8d3c03aee844a0b60a97.summary: Added `clampTerminalTimeoutSeconds` to `run-terminal-command.ts` to enforce a 600-second maximum on model-supplied `timeout_seconds`, preserving the `-1` sentinel and defaulting to 30 for invalid values. Updated `basher.ts` schema descriptions to warn against over-long budgets and document the clamp. This prevents models from setting excessively long timeouts (e.g., 50 minutes) for fast commands, which previously caused users to wait through hangs without intervention. The change applies to synchronous commands; `-1` and `process_type: BACKGROUND` remain unaffected for open-ended tasks.

c7445e24582aabfa1c2f45c2108982511769385a.title: Remove HY3 from Freebuff free mode
c7445e24582aabfa1c2f45c2108982511769385a.summary: HY3 wire ids removed from free-mode allowlist and bundled roots on 2026-08-04. Picker-retired since initial web rollout; direct API access remained possible until this full removal. Constants retained for paid/BYOK routing in `web/src/llm-api/hy3-fallback.ts`, mirroring paid Kimi precedent. `FREEBUFF_HY3_MODEL_ID` and `FREEBUFF_HY3_OPENROUTER_PAID_MODEL_ID` deleted from `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and `FREEBUFF_WEB_RETIRED_PICKER_MODEL_IDS`.

76020951df33514036c99751ccb03abd92b47274.title: normalizeClientUserAgent util added to common/src/util
76020951df33514036c99751ccb03abd92b47274.summary: New `common/src/util/client-user-agent.ts` exports `normalizeClientUserAgent` and `clientUserAgentFields` to parse HTTP User-Agent headers into bounded analytics tokens. Root cause: `session.fingerprint_id` is client-supplied and previously triggered a 659-account false-positive ban on 2026-08-03; this adds an independent signal for `Freebuff-CLI/<version>` detection. Scope: shared core utility only, no enforcement logic attached. Detail: RFC 7231 parsing drops all commentary after first whitespace, rejects `@` in product tokens to prevent address leakage, and collapses values >32 chars to `unrecognized` to bound cardinality.

218d2266be52bd7c37ca12f32c07766f8f7c267b.title: Add Greg 2 Ultra and Greg 2 Super to free agent constants
218d2266be52bd7c37ca12f32c07766f8f7c267b.summary: Added FREEBUFF_GREG_2_ULTRA_MODEL_ID and FREEBUFF_GREG_2_SUPER_MODEL_ID to shared constants in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. New root agents base2-free-greg-2-ultra and base2-free-greg-2-super registered in FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS, FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_ID_BY_MODEL, and FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS. Scope limited to core shared constants; no CLI picker or docs changes in this diff.

2e0d17a8eb3b3bf8b25564ff44b3338348cbfc63.title: Add Web onboarding, tour, and gate redirect analytics events
2e0d17a8eb3b3bf8b25564ff44b3338348cbfc63.summary: Added five analytics event enums in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts covering Web creation gate redirects, first-session onboarding steps/completion, and workspace spotlight tour steps/completion. These track user drop-off and funnel completion across Web surfaces. Gate redirects pair with Convex web_gate_decision rows to separate 'did redirect land?' (PostHog) from 'which ideas?' (Convex). Onboarding and tour events capture per-step answered/skipped states and final completion metrics.

dd1e2cfc9f90b5c1b0c2e056e7eecf45ae0c7cd5.title: Move enableMapSet from init-app to per-store immer imports
dd1e2cfc9f90b5c1b0c2e056e7eecf45ae0c7cd5.summary: CLI state stores now call `enableMapSet()` at module scope instead of relying on a global init in `init-app.ts`. Root cause: immer's Map/Set support is process-global, so centralizing it in init made direct store imports throw `[Immer] minified error nr: 0` and tests pass only by import-order luck. Scope: `chat-store.ts`, `feedback-store.ts`, `message-block-store.ts`, `publish-store.ts`, and `init-app.ts`. `enableMapSet()` is idempotent, so per-store calls are safe and make each store self-contained on import.

a47be121a650358f747794cf743870e75d35e6b3.title: Rename agent test files to run scripts
a47be121a650358f747794cf743870e75d35e6b3.summary: Renamed browser-use.test.ts to run-browser-use.ts and librarian.test.ts to run-librarian.ts. These scripts require real API keys and call process.exit(1) if agents are missing, breaking `bun test` summaries when included in the glob. Updated `test` scripts in agents, code-map, and llm-providers to explicitly exclude e2e and integration tests.

adf5bef2be7cd107b6fdefb43b9e9e6fffadf1d7.title: Add Greg 2 Ultra / Super CrofAI models
adf5bef2be7cd107b6fdefb43b9e9e6fffadf1d7.summary: Adds `crof/greg-2-ultra` and `crof/greg-2-super` to `FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODELS` and `FREEBUFF_WEB_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Cost drives god-only gating: Ultra bills ~21x input / 36x output vs DeepSeek V4 Flash, plus ~17k-token hidden preamble inflating bare requests ~3,000x. Premium pool inclusion prevents unmetered exposure via `FREEBUFF_WEB_STANDARD_MODEL_IDS` `!premium` filter. Both int4-quantized, 229,376-token context, verified streaming and tool calls.

9c3d9f0caebc6cd1ad214b92a7440fd0ff1cf929.title: Bump freebuff CLI package version to 0.0.138
9c3d9f0caebc6cd1ad214b92a7440fd0ff1cf929.summary: Version bump in freebuff/cli/release/package.json from 0.0.137 to 0.0.138. Reflects standard release cycle for the CLI package.

e4a3a7abe1a6db3cdb1a3ff7ad5bae9737e48fa3.title: Add FREEBUFFSESSIONGRACEMS for session drain window
e4a3a7abe1a6db3cdb1a3ff7ad5bae9737e48fa3.summary: Added FREEBUFF_SESSION_GRACE_MS constant (30 minutes) to define the drain window after a session's expires_at. This allows the gate to serve in-flight agent runs while blocking new prompts, distinguishing finishing runs from dead tabs. The client uses this to stop heartbeats once the row passes the grace period, syncing with server-side getSessionGraceMs(). Scope limited to common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts.

4f9fad7460a17948620ee4c82d02a3ddb4bba868.title: Add x-freebuff-takeover-instance-id header constant
4f9fad7460a17948620ee4c82d02a3ddb4bba868.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_TAKEOVER_INSTANCE_HEADER` (`x-freebuff-takeover-instance-id`) to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Provides an explicit escape hatch for Desktop's 'Use it here' action when the single-slot holder is alive on an unreachable machine or window. The server only honors this header if the instance ID matches the holder identified in the rejection, preventing stale cards from terminating unrelated tabs.

9bf66ff09f2303f7bc13ebb134678c45869f2e30.title: CLI status bar surfaces free-mode capacity deferrals
9bf66ff09f2303f7bc13ebb134678c45869f2e30.summary: SDK exposes setFreeModeCapacityDeferralListener to surface server 429 free_mode_capacity_deferred errors. CLI chat-store tracks isCapacityWait, rendering 'high demand — in line, starting soon...' instead of generic 'retrying...'. Covers cli/src/chat.tsx, status-bar.tsx, chat-store.ts, sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts. Listener clones response body for best-effort parsing; retry-after header defaults to 10s.

383fb0ceededb4056d40b1f6db984a321b7feb21.title: CLI streak rendering fixes glyph tofu and heading overlap
383fb0ceededb4056d40b1f6db984a321b7feb21.summary: Landing screen streak line now uses •/· glyphs instead of ●/○ to prevent tofu boxes in CP437-derived terminal fonts. Heading and streak share a row only if they fit, enforced by `fitsFreebuffStreakOnHeadingRow` and `FREEBUFF_STREAK_INLINE_GAP` (3 cols), preventing concatenation like "Start coding for free18 day streak". Streak dots render as spans for identical placement beside heading or on own line. Shared `getFreebuffStreakLine` in `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts` accepts `FreebuffStreakDotChars` for surface-specific glyphs; CLI passes `TERMINAL_DOT_CHARS` in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts`.

60dd01fe109f976b0e1e7eea23b9bd0e3ba67b6e.title: GLM 5.2 limited-tier access via bounty grants
60dd01fe109f976b0e1e7eea23b9bd0e3ba67b6e.summary: GLM 5.2 is now reachable from limited-tier access when backed by a bounty-earned grant. The `isGlmRedeemableAtLimitedTier` helper in `freebuff-models.ts` bypasses the `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS` allowlist, shifting the gate to the quota pool. `freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` updates the `isLocked` state to depend solely on `weeklySessionsRemaining` rather than `accessTier`, allowing limited users with active grants to see the unlocked card.

81bb087616c1eebb0516d8c74562cd6c4cd3cdbf.title: Add 37 disposable email domains to blocklist
81bb087616c1eebb0516d8c74562cd6c4cd3cdbf.summary: Expanded DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS in common/src/util/disposable-email.ts with 37 new entries. Domains selected via production data analysis: >=20 accounts and >=75% ban rate, excluding major providers like Gmail/Outlook. Targets high-volume spam and Gmail lookalikes (e.g., gmaiko, gmito) minted in single-day bursts.

4d3c46a551d4e0e3f37e902090ea267ec9b9ab5e.title: Block proxyvpn.cn and qd.je domains on behavioural evidence
4d3c46a551d4e0e3f37e902090ea267ec9b9ab5e.summary: Added proxyvpn.cn, impact.qd.je, and fincy.qd.je to DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS in common/src/util/disposable-email.ts. Domains qualify via silent-endpoint abuse and same-day account bursts despite falling below the >=20-account statistical threshold. Deliberately excluded dns-proxy.com and proximus.lu to prevent false positives from real ISPs. Blocklist relies on domain-specific entries rather than substring matching to avoid collateral damage.

f28ecce37f526a75beecd2e0c8d82da50630abba.title: MiMo Pro free agents removed; GLM 5.2 single-route enforced
f28ecce37f526a75beecd2e0c8d82da50630abba.summary: Deleted `base2-free-mimo-pro` and `code-reviewer-mimo-pro` agents following MiMo 2.5 Pro's 2026-07-31 picker retirement and subsequent user dropoff. Consolidated GLM 5.2 routing by removing the legacy `FREEBUFF_CROF_GLM_V52_MODEL_ID` and its `base2-free-glm-crof` agent, leaving `z-ai/glm-5.2` as the sole referral-gated entry point. Changes apply to `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts`, affecting Web, CLI, and Desktop model pickers. GLM 5.2 remains excluded from the shared daily premium pool (`FREEBUFF_WEB_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS`) to preserve its earned-entitlement quota logic.

04d4379f1617e48948e10d522ee2688dd9b84942.title: Fix nested gitignore pattern matching
04d4379f1617e48948e10d522ee2688dd9b84942.summary: Replaced manual gitignore pattern rebasing with a directory-aware ignore chain in `project-file-tree.ts`. The `parseGitignore` function now returns raw patterns, and a new `isIgnored` helper evaluates files against parent directory scopes using `DirIgnore` structures. This fixes incorrect matching for nested `.gitignore` files that previously failed due to flawed path rewriting logic.

af3257b3b7d7a81bde74a67d84d9a683478b684d.title: Desktop failed turn recovery event added to always-track analytics
af3257b3b7d7a81bde74a67d84d9a683478b684d.summary: Analytics now unconditionally tracks `DESKTOP_FAILED_TURN_RECOVERY` in `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts`. Low-volume recovery funnel requires full sampling to measure creation-to-success and repeated-failure rates. Covers shared core constants and sampling utility. Event added to `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` alongside `DESKTOP_TURN_STALLED` to prevent statistical gaps in reliability metrics.

d1c94381b39773dbd68e9c7ebbd4909724179110.title: CLI terminal command broker replaces isolation controller
d1c94381b39773dbd68e9c7ebbd4909724179110.summary: CLI entry point and build scripts now use `cli/src/entry.ts` to launch a dedicated terminal command broker instead of the previous isolation controller. This change ensures interactive shells do not share the host console with child processes, preventing focus and input state corruption during command execution. The refactor touches `cli/package.json`, `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts`, `cli/src/commands/router.ts`, and `cli/src/utils/codebuff-client.ts`, while renaming smoke test artifacts to reflect the new broker terminology. Headless SDK consumers may omit the broker and continue using the direct process runner.

037b51122b8b627807b9f138f7fffa16b0a6fe65.title: Add desktop download click analytics event
037b51122b8b627807b9f138f7fffa16b0a6fe65.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_DOWNLOAD_CLICKED` to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. This event tracks clicks on desktop download CTAs across the home hero, products row, and `/desktop` page. The payload includes `location` for the CTA, `platform` for the build, and a `repeat` flag to identify swallowed double-clicks.

542451446bb2086182f9a10dfd9dc56cece4c133.title: llm.ts adds abortSignal to streamText
542451446bb2086182f9a10dfd9dc56cece4c133.summary: Added `abortSignal: params.signal` to `streamText` call in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`. Passes external abort signal to AI SDK stream. Enables cancellation of streaming requests.

0251dddf1475cf3bd2449b2fe3f4cb429903459d.title: Reword fetch idle timeout error message
0251dddf1475cf3bd2449b2fe3f4cb429903459d.summary: Updated `FETCH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_USER_MESSAGE` in `common/src/util/error.ts` to remove definitive network blame. The previous copy assumed server heartbeats covered all silence, but slow model starts triggered the same `TimeoutError`. New text cites 'slow model start' as a valid cause alongside network drops. Documentation for `isFetchIdleTimeoutError` also clarified to reflect header-wait scenarios.

eeb5209f0d72ca408c7decfcbac295cf21d06cea.title: base2-free-fable reviewer runs Fable
eeb5209f0d72ca408c7decfcbac295cf21d06cea.summary: base2-free-fable reviewer now runs Fable instead of falling back to code-reviewer-deepseek-flash. Session gate rejects cross-model subagents, preventing DeepSeek Flash review on Fable-bound sessions. Changes base2-free-fable.ts comments and configuration. Eliminates unmapped model fallback for this agent.

32405d54b26ef83e80be7c091a8c9610c6bf3b8a.title: Terminal protocol controller replaces Windows command guard
32405d54b26ef83e80be7c091a8c9610c6bf3b8a.summary: New `terminal-protocol-controller.ts` replaces `windows-terminal-command-guard.ts` to isolate interactive terminal protocols during command execution. Focus state parsing moved from `use-terminal-focus.ts` to the controller, which subscribes to OpenTUI's protocol events and suppresses mode restoration during commands. The controller acquires isolation synchronously before spawn; interactive hosts fail closed if isolation cannot be established, preventing child process creation. New smoke test `cli/scripts/smoke-terminal-isolation-windows.ts` validates the isolation on packaged Windows binaries via winpty.

12660b067482362d977d9d423b6a2c107ad0c76c.title: output-limit recovery handles normal stops after reasoning
12660b067482362d977d9d423b6a2c107ad0c76c.summary: Stream recovery logic now classifies 'output-limit' for streams ending with a normal stop after emitting only native reasoning, not just length-based stops. This prevents silent turn failures when models think without answering. Changes span SDK stream interruption detection, agent runtime tags, and common type contracts.

f56844fd118df56422c40c55968c247d6253c562.title: Windows terminal command guard suppresses stray mouse and focus
f56844fd118df56422c40c55968c247d6253c562.summary: Added `installWindowsTerminalCommandGuard` to disable focus reporting and mouse mode during terminal command execution on Windows. This prevents console-attached descendants from bypassing stdio pipes via CONIN$/CONOUT$ and painting unsolicited reports over the TUI. The guard consumes focus events from OpenTUI's parser while active to prevent accidental mode restoration, relying on new `subscribeToTerminalCommandState` hooks in the SDK to manage lifecycle.

cfefab1485351974f3ed0461c9d4797fbb251c9d.title: CLI wrapper enforces semver metadata validation
cfefab1485351974f3ed0461c9d4797fbb251c9d.summary: Launcher `compareVersions` replaced with strict semver regex parser and `BigInt` comparison in `cli/release-core/launcher.js`. Invalid cached metadata now returns null, forcing wrapper self-repair instead of trusting stale versions. `wrapperVersion` injected from `package.json` into `freebuff/cli/release/index.js`, `cli/release/index.js`, and `cli/release-staging/index.js`. Prerelease segments with leading zeros are rejected during parse.

33d6139537ac60f9e475e9ff4211498fd9f65c73.title: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.136
33d6139537ac60f9e475e9ff4211498fd9f65c73.summary: freebuff/cli/release/package.json version field updated from 0.0.135 to 0.0.136. No other package metadata or dependency changes.

5423683dc8558497f5168a3e65a61e9a5e01e0ad.title: Add Fable reviewer, drop thinker-gpt for Fable root
5423683dc8558497f5168a3e65a61e9a5e01e0ad.summary: Added code-reviewer-fable agent and mapped FREEBUFF_FABLE_5_MODEL_ID to it in FREEBUFF_REVIEWER_AGENT_ID_BY_MODEL. Introduced noThinkerGpt flag in createBase2, set true for base2-free-fable to remove thinker-gpt from spawn list and prompt. This prevents wasted spawns when the root model is already frontier-grade. Scope includes agents/base2, agents/reviewer, and common/src/constants/free-agents.ts.

8c9929fa0f77987bcfd64f0625b68a97cf9dc17b.title: Fix Windows tar path in self-update test script
8c9929fa0f77987bcfd64f0625b68a97cf9dc17b.summary: The `cli/scripts/test-published-self-update.ts` script now explicitly resolves the path to Windows' native `bsdtar` (`System32\tar.exe`) instead of relying on the generic `tar` command. This change prevents Git Bash's GNU `tar` from misinterpreting Windows paths as obsolete remote tape addresses during archive extraction.
