59f2ba13cee05f37282e74d3738adfe15633ef31.summary: cli/scripts/smoke-binary.ts adds MAX_BOOT_ATTEMPTS = 3 to retry boot detection on transient Windows runner hangs. runBootAttempt isolates spawn and output capture, returning an AttemptOutcome union. Negative gate first: known fatal markers fail immediately without retrying. Positive gate: boot signal match exits 0; no-signal triggers next attempt.

de1f1f716ab020ce631b126794f4de1a48daa13f.title: Referral tier daily limits raised across all tiers
de1f1f716ab020ce631b126794f4de1a48daa13f.summary: Standard and premium model daily limits increased in FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_TIERS. Tier 0 standard limit moves from 20 to 24, premium from 3 to 4. Tier 1 standard limit moves from 30 to 40, premium from 4 to 6. Tier 2 standard limit moves from 50 to 70, premium from 6 to 10. Tier 3 standard limit moves from 80 to 110, premium from 10 to 15.

747abe3c717770a91c955c6e004da6e4154eb159.title: freebuff 0.0.110 release
747abe3c717770a91c955c6e004da6e4154eb159.summary: Version bump to 0.0.110 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No functional changes.

a94090ee7b615e9cb447b239791b4a5fb1dde283.title: Lite mode switches from DeepSeek V4 Flash to MiniMax M3
a94090ee7b615e9cb447b239791b4a5fb1dde283.summary: Lite mode now defaults to MiniMax M3 via Fireworks AI API, replacing DeepSeek V4 Flash. Free mode remains on MiniMax, and free clients continue selecting explicit variants from the model picker. Change applies to agents/base2/base2.ts. Freebuff clients select explicit free variants from the model picker.

cd4e11ce2c5b9b4f3a216ab5c0f02dcfeac333e3.title: SuggestedPrompts visibility logic updated in CLI chat
cd4e11ce2c5b9b4f3a216ab5c0f02dcfeac333e3.summary: SuggestedPrompts rendering moved to top of chat view in cli/src/chat.tsx. Visibility now requires showOnboardingPrompts, !reviewMode, and !isFreebuffSessionOver. This ensures prompts only appear during active, non-review sessions.

a4f5d94ecbd0e09f41c432abf7115b65eb498f3e.title: CLI mirrors analytics to Axiom logs pre-auth
a4f5d94ecbd0e09f41c432abf7115b65eb498f3e.summary: CLI analytics events now mirror to the Axiom logs sink via `enqueueClientLog`, enabling install-to-login funnels in APL. `log-shipper.ts` removed the auth gate, posting batches anonymously when no token exists, correlated by `client_session_id`. New `common/src/util/log-mirror.ts` filters high-volume PostHog auto-events like `$snapshot` from the Axiom copy, while `common/src/util/rate-limit.ts` adds a fixed-window limiter for unauthenticated `/api/logs` ingest.

25b6dde3bbfade9e2e2423e30c20766f5c73d2b9.title: Bump freebuff CLI release version to 0.0.108
25b6dde3bbfade9e2e2423e30c20766f5c73d2b9.summary: Version field in freebuff/cli/release/package.json incremented from 0.0.107 to 0.0.108. This is a routine release packaging update for the CLI distribution. No functional code changes or dependency updates included in this diff.

b9439256f51364c82f6d6a551a213ae995a8813c.title: CLI waiting-room promotes ASCII logo when model picker collapses
b9439256f51364c82f6d6a551a213ae995a8813c.summary: FreebuffModelSelector now emits onExpandedChange to mirror its collapsed state to WaitingRoomScreen. The waiting-room screen uses this to promote the compact wordmark to the full ASCII logo when the picker is collapsed on mid-height terminals (>= 26 rows), filling otherwise dead space. Covers cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx and cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx. useLayoutEffect ensures the parent's logo decision settles before paint, preventing layout flicker on mount and toggle.

a54b61094c5a8b141e2d1f4dd365e538ffb8529c.title: CLI model picker collapses to recommended hero; MiniMax M3 untraced
a54b61094c5a8b141e2d1f4dd365e538ffb8529c.summary: The CLI model selector now defaults to a collapsed state showing only the recommended model, enabling single-Enter starts for new users. A sentinel ID drives the expand/collapse toggle, which remains keyboard-navigable alongside model rows. This behavior applies to the landing screen when the saved preference matches the recommendation; in-queue switchers and mismatched preferences remain expanded. MiniMax M3 loses its 'Collects data for training' warning, removing it from `FREEBUFF_TRACED_MODEL_IDS` as Fireworks hosting prevents provider-side training.

7f268e15a4c0210e7b041f3cbb2265db15d97167.title: gravitySurface drops existingMetadata surface fallback
7f268e15a4c0210e7b041f3cbb2265db15d97167.summary: Refactor `gravitySurface` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/gravity-index.ts` to derive attribution solely from `agentTemplate.id`. Removes logic checking `existingMetadata.surface`, eliminating the fallback to prior metadata. This simplifies the handler call site by passing only the template object.

f0c65d3132424eafe090f368fc5615f2ced05c62.title: CLI log shipper mirrors logs to /api/logs
f0c65d3132424eafe090f368fc5615f2ced05c62.summary: Added client-side log shipper in `cli/src/utils/log-shipper.ts` that batches and POSTs CLI logs to `/api/logs` (Axiom sink). Runs alongside PostHog, best-effort, fire-and-forget, never throws. Controlled by `CODEBUFF_SHIP_LOGS` env var (default on outside dev/test/CI). New schemas in `common/src/schemas/logs.ts` enforce caps: 500 records/batch, 4KB message, 64KB data, 1MB body.

f0766573fad36c88ba482c7873e7054124140720.title: gravity-index surface resolution now checks existing metadata
f0766573fad36c88ba482c7873e7054124140720.summary: gravitySurface in gravity-index.ts now accepts existingMetadata and returns its surface field if present, falling back to the agentTemplate.id check otherwise. This preserves previously assigned attribution surfaces during tool calls instead of overwriting them with derived defaults. Scope: packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/gravity-index.ts. The existing surface value must be a non-empty string to take precedence.

370bbb64e5b86de777b8ded4303ad082fcf80b06.title: Web referral tiers: 4-month GitHub age gate
370bbb64e5b86de777b8ded4303ad082fcf80b06.summary: New `common/src/constants/freebuff-referral-tiers.ts` defines Web referral ladder (1/3/7 qualified referrals) scaling daily model limits and unlocking deploy watermark removal. Referrals require referred user's GitHub account to be at least 4 months old at signup (anti-farming), computed on calendar months. `FREEBUFF_WEB_REFERRAL_LIMIT` set to 20 to bound farming while accommodating unqualified signups, distinct from CLI's `user.referral_limit` default of 5.

ccac201df6fc4a1ab037a5d13c930a49e65459fe.title: Clarify referral tier limits for geo-gated regions
ccac201df6fc4a1ab037a5d13c930a49e65459fe.summary: Updated documentation in `freebuff-referral-tiers.ts` to specify that while users in limited regions can still unlock referral tiers, only standard/free-model limits apply because premium models remain geo-gated. This clarifies the mechanism for tier scaling and perks in restricted areas. The change is isolated to the shared constants file and does not affect core logic or CLI behavior.

d38aa87d8f52653a6efbd545aba736173cf07a89.title: Add agentId to reasoning chunks
d38aa87d8f52653a6efbd545aba736173cf07a89.summary: The SDK's run.ts and agent-runtime stream-parser now emit a stable agentId in reasoning chunks instead of runId. This allows consumers to correctly attribute reasoning to the specific subagent (e.g., thinker-gemini) by matching the agentId from subagent_start events. The change touches common/src/types/print-mode.ts schema and sdk/src/run.ts. Base-chat.ts also updated to spawnableAgents include 'thinker-gemini' with new reasoning delegation instructions.

ed764c4f8db46d834c0b0f04883fee15b35c4c55.title: Smoke binary accepts OpenTUI terminal handshakes as boot signals
ed764c4f8db46d834c0b0f04883fee15b35c4c55.summary: cli/scripts/smoke-binary.ts adds OpenTUI alternate-screen and Kitty keyboard protocol escape sequences to BOOT_SIGNAL_PATTERNS. Fixes flaky Windows GitHub Actions smoke tests where the binary emits terminal setup but fails to flush static React text before timeout. Accepting these handshakes proves the renderer reached the post-init terminal surface. Fatal markers and tree-sitter checks still fail the smoke if async startup breaks later.

874c8ec4aabb8c0db77ffe375d5edd248402a83a.title: Add Kimi K2.7 Code agent and model constant
874c8ec4aabb8c0db77ffe375d5edd248402a83a.summary: New `base2-kimi-2-7-code` agent definition added, utilizing `moonshotModels.kimiK27Code`. `moonshotModels` constant introduced in `model-config.ts` and `ModelName` type updated in `agent-definition.ts` to include `moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code`. `FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID` refactored to use `moonshotModels.kimiK26` instead of hardcoded string. BuffBench eval config updated to run the new agent.

7f85312af394fa37a87011970442a28c6c728292.title: Expand gemini-thinker parent models and refine prompts
7f85312af394fa37a87011970442a28c6c728292.summary: Added MiMo 2.5 Pro and MiniMax M3 to FREEBUFF_GEMINI_THINKER_PARENT_MODELS in freebuff-models.ts, expanding deep reasoning availability to all full-access models except limited tiers. Updated system, instruction, and step prompts in freebuff-gemini-thinker.ts to broaden trigger conditions from "complex problems" to "problems worth thinking through," explicitly including non-trivial bugs and uncertain approaches. The CLI and server use this set to toggle spawnability and admit child requests, while the legacy Fastest MiniMax M2.7 remains excluded to preserve latency.

957b9d654a945dcb47e4d91b473f0212e1565ad3.title: Prevent CLI crashes on WSL and headless Linux browser open
957b9d654a945dcb47e4d91b473f0212e1565ad3.summary: The `safeOpen` utility now explicitly checks for `powershell.exe` accessibility on WSL and attaches an error listener to the spawned process. This prevents uncaught exceptions that terminate the CLI when Windows interop is disabled or when `xdg-open` fails on headless Linux systems. The change adds `wsl-utils` as a dependency in `cli/package.json` to align path resolution with the underlying `open` library.

4999c63158f0f57c511141ac4277be73ca153b19.title: Freebuff CLI release package.json bumped to 0.0.107
4999c63158f0f57c511141ac4277be73ca153b19.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json updated from 0.0.106 to 0.0.107. Scope limited to CLI release packaging metadata.

9c8af8c79c36649273421ef43e515b2fffe63be3.title: Shallow scan for home directory roots in CLI file tree
9c8af8c79c36649273421ef43e515b2fffe63be3.summary: CLI `@` mention file tree now performs a shallow capped scan when project root is home directory or ancestor, replacing previous full disablement. `isShallowScanRoot` and `SHALLOW_SCAN_MAX_DEPTH` (3) gate behavior in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts`, limiting crawl to `SHALLOW_SCAN_MAX_FILES` (2000) and `SHALLOW_SCAN_MAX_DIRS` (500) to prevent disk-wide traversal. `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx` adds footer hint via `tryGetProjectRoot()` when shallow mode active, rendered by updated `SuggestionMenu` in `cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx`. Directories beyond depth 3 appear as nodes but contents remain unscanned.

9d9e3f15ad1e2fd45a3501a73a9ea9d5acc8ed79.title: base-chat gains gravityindex tool
9d9e3f15ad1e2fd45a3501a73a9ea9d5acc8ed79.summary: base-chat agent toolNames expanded with gravity_index. System prompt updated to instruct gravity_index usage for third-party service recommendations, with specific formatting for setup links. gravity-index.ts handler modified to accept agentTemplate parameter. New gravitySurface helper maps agentTemplate.id to surface string ('freebuff_chat' for base-chat, 'codebuff_cli' otherwise), replacing hardcoded 'codebuff_cli' in metadata. This ensures clicks/conversions are attributable to the originating product.

778c6c18965612446c6b4fb568cba5120399fd94.title: Prevent code reviewer spawning for non-code changes
778c6c18965612446c6b4fb568cba5120399fd94.summary: Added prompt logic to agents/base2/base2.ts to explicitly instruct the agent not to spawn a code reviewer when no code changes are made (e.g., planning or answering questions). This applies to default, max, and free models to prevent unnecessary reviewer invocations.

ff6f49149b964e3c2f917756c7979cb61ecffe8d.title: Fix agent runtime state leak on abort, bound SDK agent cache
ff6f49149b964e3c2f917756c7979cb61ecffe8d.summary: Added clearProgrammaticRunState in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts to release generator, STEP_ALL flag, and proposed file content on abort/error exits, not just endTurn. Wrapped loopAgentSteps in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts with finally block calling this cleanup. Replaced unbounded Map with BoundedAgentCache (200 entries, FIFO eviction) in sdk/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts to prevent memory growth in long-lived processes.

8118a50f77cd572f2b9a82fb5e8525e23aec4d25.title: CLI model selector layout updates
8118a50f77cd572f2b9a82fb5e8525e23aec4d25.summary: CLI model selector layout updates. Premium/Unlimited headers now show reset countdowns and no-limit labels. Streak and limited-mode notices render below the picker. Compact terminals hide the notice. Country codes format to names with fallbacks.

5f95e26baf6768feb52cc5e67519b4cede3d4a63.title: Add Freebuff Web tier, geo-exempt models, limited session pool
5f95e26baf6768feb52cc5e67519b4cede3d4a63.summary: Introduces Freebuff Web-specific access tiers and model gating in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Extends FreebuffAccessTier with 'blocked' for Tor/anonymous networks, rejecting agent sends server-side. Defines a Convex-enforced limited session pool (5 sessions, 1h) separate from CLI Postgres, plus geo-exempt models (DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiMo 2.5) allowing unlimited usage for limited-tier Web users. Includes helper functions to validate and coerce model selections for limited tiers.

0a3669024953392e5c7b6171940113766df9c728.title: Fetch idle timeout detection and clearer user messaging
0a3669024953392e5c7b6171940113766df9c728.summary: Added `isFetchIdleTimeoutError` to detect Bun's 5-minute fetch inactivity timeout (DOMException `TimeoutError`) and `FETCH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_USER_MESSAGE` to replace the raw runtime error with actionable network-path guidance. `run-agent-step.ts` and `sdk/run.ts` now route detected idle timeouts to the user-facing message instead of the generic `Agent run error:` prefix. `sdk/impl/database.ts` truncates persisted `errorMessage` to 5000 chars to prevent stack-trace bloat. Covers `common/src/util/error.ts`, Agent Runtime, and SDK surfaces.

e459f2a24426424306293d667cef2ef135ed1cbc.title: Replace claude-fable-5 with claude-opus-4.8 in Max agents
e459f2a24426424306293d667cef2ef135ed1cbc.summary: Claude-fable-5 replaced by claude-opus-4.8 across Max-tier agents including base2, best-of-n selector, editor implementors, and code reviewers. Fable model options removed from createBestOfNSelector2, createBestOfNImplementor, and createThinkerBestOfN type unions. Agent IDs and spawnableAgents updated from fable variants to opus variants (e.g., thinker-best-of-n-fable to thinker-best-of-n-opus). Bedrock providerOptions now apply only to isOpus checks.

6c85a772586aa5d0ba7760d5ee1cad1723317bf0.title: Base-chat agent switches to DeepSeek V4 Flash on Fireworks
6c85a772586aa5d0ba7760d5ee1cad1723317bf0.summary: The `base-chat` agent definition now uses `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_FIREWORKS_MODEL_ID` (`fireworks/deepseek-v4-flash`) instead of the direct DeepSeek API constant. This change targets freebuff.com/chat specifically, leveraging Fireworks' faster inference despite a slight capability trade-off. The new model ID is defined in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` but intentionally excluded from `SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS` and free-mode allowlists, ensuring CLI and web builder agents continue using the direct DeepSeek endpoint.

a6455dbd1cff1467ef80a3c7ce9d364e19756b09.title: Claude Fable 5 replaces Opus 4.7 in max-tier agents; Opus bumps to 4.8
a6455dbd1cff1467ef80a3c7ce9d364e19756b09.summary: Claude Fable 5 (`anthropic/claude-fable-5`) replaces Claude Opus 4.7 as the primary model for `editor-multi-prompt`, `code-reviewer-multi-prompt`, and `best-of-n-selector2` in max-tier workflows. Claude Opus 4.7 is globally bumped to Opus 4.8 (`anthropic/claude-opus-4.8`) for `editor`, `general-agent`, and `code-reviewer`. New `code-reviewer-fable.ts` and renamed `thinker-best-of-n-fable.ts` / `editor-implementor-fable.ts` files update agent IDs and spawnable lists in `context-pruner.ts` and `base2.ts`. All Fable and Opus models strictly enforce `amazon-bedrock` provider routing.

f63541370c2725c95b8e38a776ce4c91402c2f7f.title: Researcher agent enforces iterative multi-round web research
f63541370c2725c95b8e38a776ce4c91402c2f7f.summary: The researcher-web agent definition in agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts now mandates iterative research. The systemPrompt warns that search snippets are not evidence, and the instructionsPrompt requires multiple rounds of web_search followed by parallel read_url calls. A hard rule prevents answering until at least 3 (or 5 for complex queries) pages are successfully fetched.

53e9e1ac09bee289c4fe62535ad8eaa07a6f2ff1.title: LoginModal adds wrap warning for truncated auth URLs
53e9e1ac09bee289c4fe62535ad8eaa07a6f2ff1.summary: LoginModal in `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx` now detects multi-line URL wrapping via `loginUrlWrapped` and renders a warning message. Terminal link detection and drag-select only capture the first row of wrapped text, causing truncated auth codes. The fix advises users to press 'c' to copy the full link.

38844c7040fd9dd3eedac0755f87c6bfe6b1f75a.title: Freebuff Chat spawns researcher-web
38844c7040fd9dd3eedac0755f87c6bfe6b1f75a.summary: Chat agent gains toolNames: ['spawn_agents'] and spawnableAgents: ['researcher-web'] in agents/base-chat.ts. researcher-web displayName changes from 'Weeb' to 'Web Researcher' in agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts. System prompt instructs spawning for current info, parallel searches, and source citation. Covers freebuff.com/chat surface.

6142b8be692c47b91afbaaced3ad6e433ab47175.title: Handle synchronous spawn errors in CLI launcher
6142b8be692c47b91afbaaced3ad6e433ab47175.summary: Wrap spawn() calls in try/catch to handle synchronous exceptions like UNKNOWN errno on Windows caused by antivirus or Smart App Control blocking the executable. Add exitOnSpawnFailure helper to centralize error printing and process exit(1) for both missing binary and spawn failures. Update cli/release/index.js and freebuff/cli/release/index.js. This ensures the CLI launcher exits cleanly instead of crashing with an unhandled promise rejection or stack trace when the binary cannot be spawned.

f5aebdb4bd86f3c4c97f01039705133a9fd2eb8f.title: SDK read-url adds SSRF protection with manual redirect validation
f5aebdb4bd86f3c4c97f01039705133a9fd2eb8f.summary: New ssrf.ts module enforces SSRF policies for read-url by validating URL schemes, IP literals, and resolved hostnames against private/reserved ranges. read-url.ts now follows redirects manually (max 5 hops) to re-validate each target, replacing native fetch redirect handling. IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (e.g. ::ffff:127.0.0.1) are normalized to their embedded IPv4 range for accurate classification. Callers can inject lookupHost or set resolveDns: false to skip DNS resolution while still blocking IP-literal targets.

66b39f9ac99af7faa8b610590717bdfa5daeb7f1.title: CLI log.jsonl summary-only, trace.jsonl opt-in, oversized log trim
66b39f9ac99af7faa8b610590717bdfa5daeb7f1.summary: use-send-message.ts logs runConfig summary (agent, promptLength, contentBlockCount, previousMessageCount, agentDefinitionCount, costMode, maxAgentSteps) instead of full runConfig, preventing multi-GB log.jsonl bloat. New trace-writer.ts and common contracts/trace.ts append per-message agent histories to trace.jsonl, gated by CODEBUFF_TRACE=1 in prod and always-on in dev; AgentRuntimeDeps gains optional traceWriter. chat-history.ts trimOversizedChatLogs deletes log.jsonl files >10MB untouched for 14+ days, deferred via setTimeout in index.tsx to keep startup off the stat sweep. logger.ts exports CHAT_LOG_FILENAME and clearLogFile now also clears debug/trace.jsonl.

c63b7942c4944f02b89d0326a45adaa3d0c3ff45.title: Add base-chat agent definition
c63b7942c4944f02b89d0326a45adaa3d0c3ff45.summary: New `agents/base-chat.ts` defines the `base-chat` agent for freebuff.com/chat. It uses `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` with zero tools and filesystem access. The agent outputs only the last message and accepts a single string prompt. Subagents and model overrides are planned for future updates.

937787d54b56ca6ee152ff1bb454214701601916.title: Add claude-fable-5 and claude-opus-4.8 model support
937787d54b56ca6ee152ff1bb454214701601916.summary: Added anthropic/claude-fable-5 and anthropic/claude-opus-4.8 to ModelName types and OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP. Base2 agent now routes isMax to claude-fable-5, else claude-opus-4.8. Updates affect agents/base2/base2.ts, agents/types/agent-definition.ts, and common constants.

44cbd349993e6f82827d8ca66c2b3dcf6634ce31.title: MiniMax M3 gets dedicated reviewer agent
44cbd349993e6f82827d8ca66c2b3dcf6634ce31.summary: Added `code-reviewer-minimax-m3` agent definition and mapped it in `FREEBUFF_REVIEWER_AGENT_ID_BY_MODEL`. Removed `noReview: true` flag from `base2-free-minimax-m3` to enable review capability. Registered model in `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` for free mode routing.

323d5e50a72afae4df7bd73a04c94ded077e8d8c.title: Bump freebuff CLI to 0.0.106
323d5e50a72afae4df7bd73a04c94ded077e8d8c.summary: Version bump in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.105 to 0.0.106. No functional code changes. Affects CLI release packaging only.

7754f72e80e57678d648b9170a9bc725d31066a6.title: Waiting room copy rework for limited mode
7754f72e80e57678d648b9170a9bc725d31066a6.summary: Waiting room screen updates limited mode copy to focus on model availability rather than access restrictions. The `getLimitedModeReason` function is renamed to `getLimitedModeNotice` with revised messaging for country blocks, VPNs, and unknown regions. The `sessionLabel` now distinguishes between 'sessions' and 'premium sessions' based on access tier. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

5d29036496273c2e61ccc2fb490f9c49826cc980.title: Improve CLI rate limit error visibility and parsing
5d29036496273c2e61ccc2fb490f9c49826cc980.summary: Enhanced CLI error handling to display specific upstream rate limit details alongside the standard Freebuff message. The `parseApiErrorResponseBody` function in `common/src/util/error.ts` now extracts nested `message` and `code` fields from OpenAI-style error objects. This allows users to see the actual provider error (e.g., from Fireworks or OpenRouter) instead of a generic 429 message.

7715a97463b9c6609c1f9e3a5d32eaf9449fb6dd.title: DEFAULTFREEBUFFMODELID switches to MiniMax M3
7715a97463b9c6609c1f9e3a5d32eaf9449fb6dd.summary: DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts changes from FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID to FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID. MiniMax M3 selected for superior intelligence and multimodal capabilities, preserving the 5/day premium quota. Affects new user defaults in core constants; existing sessions and fallback logic remain unchanged. FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID stays distinct to handle resolution errors.

409f05fafae7718d0ff9fa5979f74f309b7bc5c0.title: CLI detects blocked OSC 52 in Codespaces and remote VS Code terminals
409f05fafae7718d0ff9fa5979f74f309b7bc5c0.summary: Added isOsc52Blocked() to detect GitHub Codespaces and remote VS Code terminals that silently drop OSC 52 sequences. Clipboard copy logic now checks this flag to bypass OSC 52 attempts and force Shift+drag guidance when no platform tool exists, even for callers suppressing routine messages. Covers cli/src/utils/clipboard.ts, cli/src/types/env.ts, cli/src/utils/env.ts, and cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx. Detection relies on TERM_PROGRAM=vscode combined with CODESPACES=true or existing SSH environment variables.

ac888447c1bb269cec8476262a11cf270b02942c.title: v0.0.105
ac888447c1bb269cec8476262a11cf270b02942c.summary: Version bump to 0.0.105. Scope limited to freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Internal packaging update.

e72bcc94a0acd7187855a568de78d5e8cfc49f74.title: Fix Claude 4.6 assistant prefill rejection in agent runtime
e72bcc94a0acd7187855a568de78d5e8cfc49f74.summary: Added `supportsAssistantPrefill` check to `common/src/constants/model-config.ts` and applied logic in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Claude 4.6+ (including Fable) rejects requests ending in an assistant message with "unsupported assistant prefill" errors, particularly via Amazon Bedrock. The runtime now ensures the conversation ends with a user message for these models, while older Claude versions and other providers retain prefill support. Buffbench error dumps matching `*-error-*.json` are now ignored via `.gitignore`.

241cc5bcc2452ac764d35c7d3557bd9490b1a852.title: Fix plain Enter detection for Kitty protocol keyboards
241cc5bcc2452ac764d35c7d3557bd9490b1a852.summary: MultilineInput now treats key.source === 'kitty' as a valid Enter signal, bypassing legacy escape-prefix and raw \r/\n heuristics. This prevents plain Enter from being misinterpreted as Alt+Enter on Kitty-protocol terminals, which encode Enter as an escape sequence (e.g. \x1b[13u) while reliably reporting modifiers. Change scoped to cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx. The isKittyKey flag explicitly disables hasEscapePrefix checks for these events to ensure accurate modifier state.

3deed7d21a3488df1deed4440a635321ec6bb445.title: CLI session summary shows remaining quota instead of used
3deed7d21a3488df1deed4440a635321ec6bb445.summary: Active session summary now displays remaining quota units rather than used units. The `recentCount` metric already includes the active session's reservation, so showing `quota.limit - quota.recentCount` accurately reflects sessions available to start. Waiting room label updated from 'sessions' to 'premium sessions' for limited tier consistency. Changes affect `freebuff-active-session-summary.tsx` and `waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

2c743c61f11ee2f2df023ddf95b3268ed4737b07.title: MiniMax M3 data collection warning and picker order
2c743c61f11ee2f2df023ddf95b3268ed4737b07.summary: MiniMax M3 adds a 'Collects data for training' warning to its model configuration. The model moves to the second position in the FREEBUFF_MODELS array, immediately after DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL. This change affects the shared constants file used by CLI and Web UI pickers.

e39f9da8bc239a0b8c08ee3014e7ec7c2a287c41.title: Add MiniMax M3 premium model and free agent
e39f9da8bc239a0b8c08ee3014e7ec7c2a287c41.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID` constant and `base2-free-minimax-m3` agent definition. 209f11b0fb3bcd73c25e68d691e48144f7cc001d.title: CLI ad banner refactor: choice-ad-banner.tsx renamed to ad-banner.tsx
209f11b0fb3bcd73c25e68d691e48144f7cc001d.summary: cli/src/components/choice-ad-banner.tsx renamed to cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx. 38401ec1b8df4542b80b71d41256a043e08f29be.title: MiniMax M3 replaces M2.7 in free model picker
38401ec1b8df4542b80b71d41256a043e08f29be.summary: MiniMax M3 added to FREEBUFF_MODELS, replacing M2.7. M3 premium flag removed from FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS. 293172345e45adda8b4ab9be0546a1b5614ad09c.title: CLI 0.0.104 active session summary shows used units
293172345e45adda8b4ab9be0546a1b5614ad09c.summary: Freebuff CLI bumped to 0.0.104. fe118aa3f6950ee3cc04197a155e65dc87a57339.title: Default model switches to DeepSeek V4 Pro
fe118aa3f6950ee3cc04197a155e65dc87a57339.summary: DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID switches from FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID to FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL_ID in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. The constant drives initial resolution and auto-fallbacks when no specific model is requested. This change applies to the shared core constants, affecting all client surfaces (Web, CLI, Desktop). f219b409368e128adf95153f694aabf896189c0e.title: Default model switched to Kimi
f219b409368e128adf95153f694aabf896189c0e.summary: DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts changed from FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL_ID to FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID. This updates the initial model selection for new sessions. Scope limited to shared core constants.

89ef2b771d74e90e173c03c80e5a0b7e1285932f.title: Verb-first labels, outlined buttons, Kimi and MiniMax M3 multimodal
89ef2b771d74e90e173c03c80e5a0b7e1285932f.summary: gravity-index.tsx replaces 'Brand · Verb' prefixes with plain verb-first labels like 'Search services' and 'List service categories'. render-ui.tsx switches buttons to unfilled accent outlines with hover underlines and trailing arrows. freebuff-models.ts marks Kimi and MiniMax M3 as multimodal, adding them to FREEBUFF_MULTIMODAL_MODEL_IDS and updating M3's tagline. Covers CLI tool rendering and shared model constants.

f34d91198316b40f048582b71a9aa915bac94a52.title: compileToolDefinitions accepts explicit tool list
f34d91198316b40f048582b71a9aa915bac94a52.summary: compileToolDefinitions in common/src/tools/compile-tool-definitions.ts now accepts an optional tools parameter, defaulting to getPublishedToolEntries(). Refactored to use a new ToolSchemaEntry interface, decoupling compilation from hardcoded publishedTools. Scope: Shared/Core. Detail: Enables tests or callers to compile definitions for specific schema subsets without modifying global constants.

a7e0fa38f02a212b5209e1dfcd97f866d9cba34e.title: MiMo 2.5 Pro tagline grammar fix
a7e0fa38f02a212b5209e1dfcd97f866d9cba34e.summary: Tagline for MiMo 2.5 Pro corrected from 'Smartest & Slower' to 'Smartest & Slow' in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Fixes inconsistent comparative adjective usage in model metadata. Scope limited to shared core constants affecting CLI, Web, and Desktop pickers.

56b18a1960ad0c308f1b210f01aa7b0fac0b98f0.title: CLI package bump to 0.0.102
56b18a1960ad0c308f1b210f01aa7b0fac0b98f0.summary: Version bumped to 0.0.102 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. Covers CLI release artifact.

ce77a82c508d26c25c88f298f9d65f4ff224125f.title: base2 agent drops isFast gate on suggestfollowups
ce77a82c508d26c25c88f298f9d65f4ff224125f.summary: suggest_followups tool and its prompt directive no longer gated on !isFast in agents/base2/base2.ts. Only !noAskUser controls availability. Fast-mode agents now receive followup suggestions. Skill-loading prompt line removed from buildImplementationStepPrompt.

270a776296bc67ae0369762cf91bc6b047ec9f69.title: Add premium and multimodal flags to model constants
270a776296bc67ae0369762cf91bc6b047ec9f69.summary: FreebuffModelOption interface gains premium and multimodal boolean fields. Multimodal flag controls image forwarding logic, backed by new FREEBUFF_MULTIMODAL_MODEL_IDS export and isFreebuffMultimodalModelId helper.

bc2e521ae7126000175fdb40f34658c9a358d7ff.title: v0.0.103 adds noReview flag, inlines JSON refs, fixes pause error
bc2e521ae7126000175fdb40f34658c9a358d7ff.summary: CLI v0.0.103 introduces `noReview` option in `createBase2` to disable free-tier code reviewer agent spawning. `openai-compatible-prepare-tools.ts` now inlines local `$ref` schemas via `inlineLocalSchemaRefs` to prevent upstream resolution failures. `sdk/src/run.ts` preserves `CodebuffRunPausedError` instead of catching it as tool failure. `common/src/env-schema.ts` adds optional `NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAVITY_PIXEL_ID`.

360988f0ed5f75d567ab892ee251a9fa0fcde802.title: gravityindex tool added to base2 agent and CLI
360988f0ed5f75d567ab892ee251a9fa0fcde802.summary: Added `gravity_index` to `base2` agent tools and updated `GravityIndexParams` type. Base2 now mandates using this tool for third-party service discovery instead of relying on memory. CLI rendering refactored to display actions as bold 'Services · <Verb>' subcommands. Covers agents, CLI, and shared types.

9e59dcc4f5df63719dff99e9e4ec1db6abcb1fbb.title: Fix CLI Enter key detection and sanitize message surrogates
9e59dcc4f5df63719dff99e9e4ec1db6abcb1fbb.summary: CLI model selector and waiting room now use `isPlainEnterKey` to correctly handle keypad Enter and linefeed, fixing frozen menu behavior on niche Linux terminals. `common/src/util/messages.ts` adds `wellFormStringsInPlace` to recursively replace lone UTF-16 surrogates with U+FFFD before provider requests. This prevents strict server-side parsers (e.g., Rust serde_json) from rejecting entire request bodies due to corrupted history from unsafe truncation. Sanitization occurs at the message conversion chokepoint, mutating fresh clones to avoid affecting local history.

4642c507f8c5fe9034ddd46a98554ba964cb16db.title: Gravity Index schema refactor and attribution metadata
4642c507f8c5fe9034ddd46a98554ba964cb16db.summary: Gravity Index tool input schema refactored into discrete Zod objects (search, browse, get_service) with explicit runtime attribution fields. Agent runtime handler now injects session, repo, and step IDs into request metadata before API call. Tool description updated to prioritize credential_request.setup_url over generic conversion links. Scope limited to common/types and agent-runtime handlers.

4b2b9ba193f215d52fdda833622d4929ab3b2be8.title: fitToolResults preserves fresh tool exchanges during history
4b2b9ba193f215d52fdda833622d4929ab3b2be8.summary: Added fitToolResults utility to agent-runtime to prevent truncation of unconsumed tool batches during history compaction. The compaction logic now reserves the latest assistant/tool exchange and calculates fixed token overhead (system prompt, schemas, next step) before summarizing older history. This ensures large fresh reads do not squeeze the active task out of the BYOK window, covering core agent loop and request budgeting.

605ba1edc6365594cf457c25adab324cb801d41c.title: Pin FREEBUFFGODQUOTAEXEMPT=on in SDK test setup
605ba1edc6365594cf457c25adab324cb801d41c.summary: sdk/test/setup-env.ts hard-sets process.env.FREEBUFF_GOD_QUOTA_EXEMPT='on' before testDefaults apply. CI loads prod Infisical secrets, so a flipped prod knob leaked into the suite and turned six exemption tests red on 2026-09-01. Scope is SDK test bootstrap only; no runtime or picker change. Tests needing the off setting must assign process.env themselves.

9175fd397356dbcfa51334ff19281711e7ade0e9.title: SDK test env defaults RUNINFRAGATEWAYKEY
9175fd397356dbcfa51334ff19281711e7ade0e9.summary: Added RUNINFRA_GATEWAY_KEY: 'test' to sdk/test/setup-env.ts serverDefaults. Ensures mocked-fetch routing tests do not depend on developer shell environment for this key. Scope limited to SDK test setup.

02082cce25560ae06491ef8c0ef30c6518b5afc7.title: Add spawn-agent-matcher tests
02082cce25560ae06491ef8c0ef30c6518b5afc7.summary: Added `cli/src/utils/__tests__/spawn-agent-matcher.test.ts` covering `findMatchingSpawnAgent` and `resolveSpawnAgentToReal`. Tests verify base name matching (ignoring scope/version/underscores) and placeholder-to-real ID resolution with nesting logic. No shipped code changes.

4ff23980eed8bb8c8060150d73829847ba390d48.title: Update live-turn e2e smoke test prompt
4ff23980eed8bb8c8060150d73829847ba390d48.summary: Replaced arithmetic smoke prompt in `freebuff/e2e/tests/live-turn.e2e.test.ts` with word generation prompt to avoid model hallucination errors. Scope limited to e2e tests; no shipped code changes.

286d268c11543e5525d49ce12cd2d707cdd5ecbc.title: E2E session cleanup fix
286d268c11543e5525d49ce12cd2d707cdd5ecbc.summary: Tests only: `live-turn.e2e.test.ts` prevents leaked sessions on assertion failure. `afterEach` now sends `/end-session` if the chat screen is active, guarded by an `ended` flag. No shipped code changes.

390944fda9461b1401383ef148dfcd844f8d4427.title: Add tests for word-wrap-utils cursor movement
390944fda9461b1401383ef148dfcd844f8d4427.summary: Added comprehensive unit tests for `calculateNewCursorPosition` in `cli/src/utils/__tests__/word-wrap-utils.test.ts`. The suite verifies up/down cursor movement, column clamping at line ends, boundary handling for first/last lines, and runtime guards for invalid directions. Scope limited to CLI test coverage; no production code changes.

c179bfcc451be624a8bffc032075ba836a5a967b.title: Tests for formatPlanUnits float rounding
c179bfcc451be624a8bffc032075ba836a5a967b.summary: Added unit tests for `formatPlanUnits` in `freebuff-plan-summary.test.ts`. Verifies rounding of IEEE 754 float artifacts (e.g., `7 - 6.3` to `0.7`) to prevent display errors in ring centres. No shipped code changes.

c53b6a752b9954bbd96a70f0d3eafd60c350491f.title: Update free-agents test regex for mission prompt renderers
c53b6a752b9954bbd96a70f0d3eafd60c350491f.summary: Updated `free-agents.test.ts` to match the new `export function renderMission...Prompt(` pattern instead of the old `render: (...) => ` arrow function syntax. The test now verifies that `return ` lines in `src/shared/mission-prompt.ts` preserve the canonical free-mode root signature at position zero. This ensures the validation logic tracks the refactor of mission prompt definitions from inline arrow functions to exported named functions. Scope limited to `common/src/__tests__/free-agents.test.ts`.

ff5d55049a4f9d7a0175b82bbc68a7c75c89e811.title: Update CLI model selector tests for tier changes
ff5d55049a4f9d7a0175b82bbc68a7c75c89e811.summary: Updated `freebuff-model-selector.test.tsx` to reflect DeepSeek V4 Flash moving from PREMIUM to UNLIMITED on 2026-08-24. The suite verifies that V4 Pro correctly displays both training warnings and quota chips without breaking layout calculations.

29e42653f8ec332f88173a5a05520ff6f8119655.title: Tests verify VPN egress action in refusal copy
29e42653f8ec332f88173a5a05520ff6f8119655.summary: Added assertions in `freebuff-spend-ceilings.test.ts` to ensure `FREEBUFF_RESTRICTED_NOTICE` explicitly mentions 'VPN' and 'connecting directly'. 9c2974837d8b90725ae61ebe6ac5c8c7f29ea493.title: Add CLI time-format unit tests
9c2974837d8b90725ae61ebe6ac5c8c7f29ea493.summary: Added `cli/src/utils/time-format.test.ts` covering `formatResetTimeLong`. 7266e1b5944dd0a7094a9cbaa49361d470b67c9e.title: Add Web catalog coverage test for subscription model ids
7266e1b5944dd0a7094a9cbaa49361d470b67c9e.summary: Added `isFreebuffWebModelId` check in `freebuff-limited-subscriber.test.ts`. 4eab91e6da752b9f8269e52018db5854dd9f0fc2.title: Test pins FREEBUFFMODELS order to default
4eab91e6da752b9f8269e52018db5854dd9f0fc2.summary: Added assertion in freebuff-models.test.ts to verify FREEBUFF_MODELS[0] matches DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID and [1] matches FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID. 9d25b4958aa958f70db200e3cbde351f54538ffd.title: Update desktop root prompt test for array join
9d25b4958aa958f70db200e3cbde351f54538ffd.summary: The canonical root prompt test for the desktop thread agent now asserts against the array join composition (`const systemPrompt = [base3.systemPrompt, ...`) instead of the previous template literal check. 2daa1edbfdcc1e2b867db89a6ee29cb5b6ac9c8f.title: Remove cross-boundary tool result test case
2daa1edbfdcc1e2b867db89a6ee29cb5b6ac9c8f.summary: Deleted `does not let a late result answer across a user boundary` from `common/src/util/__tests__/messages.test.ts`. Tests only; no shipped code changes. Scope limited to unit test suite.

5db7bafe633f286ebf8cb91d151d557ce8df3db1.title: Rename thinker-codex to thinker-gpt in E2E tests
5db7bafe633f286ebf8cb91d151d557ce8df3db1.summary: Tests only. `base-deep.e2e.test.ts` renames imports and assertions from `thinker-codex` to `thinker-gpt`. `context-pruning-threshold.e2e.test.ts` removes `expect(tokenCount).toBeLessThan(50_000)` because the pruner fires on `contextTokenCount + TOKEN_COUNT_FUDGE_FACTOR > maxContextLength`, making the assertion contradictory.

f831624f857d2174a4f72a594f53e8cdec65e528.title: launcher-disconnect test drains output on exit
f831624f857d2174a4f72a594f53e8cdec65e528.summary: Updated `launcher-disconnect.test.ts` to resolve on `child.once('exit')` rather than `close`, adding a `OUTPUT_DRAIN_MS` (750ms) timer to capture stdout/stderr. This prevents test hangs when grandchild processes inherit stdio and keep pipes open, ensuring the fixture's exit code and diagnostic output are captured before the 15s timeout. Scope limited to CLI test infrastructure; no shipped code changes.

51994660ab6530ff0764978a8241ed2b80fa1d30.title: terminal-watchdog test hardens reset-sequence polling
51994660ab6530ff0764978a8241ed2b80fa1d30.summary: terminal-watchdog.test.ts replaces truthy `pollForContent` check with exact `TERMINAL_RESET_SEQUENCES` match. Timeout shifts to platform-aware `WATCHDOG_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS` (45s win32, 15s POSIX); test limits raised to 120s. Scope limited to `cli/src/__tests__/terminal-watchdog.test.ts`. Windows SIGKILL reset path now asserts byte-for-byte output, not non-empty.

0be72bef521398a74121b5719210a8c5c2e1abfb.title: Split launcher disconnect fixture into two timeout clocks
0be72bef521398a74121b5719210a8c5c2e1abfb.summary: Launcher disconnect fixture split into `READY_TIMEOUT_MS` (15s) and `SURVIVAL_TIMEOUT_MS` (6s). Boot time no longer consumes survival budget. Test timeout raised to 30s. Files: `cli/src/__tests__/helpers/launcher-disconnect-fixture.cjs`, `cli/src/__tests__/launcher-disconnect.test.ts`.

f9ccbec282a4812b8d2e12af28d75395af286030.title: Desktop mission prompt canonical test covers all variants
f9ccbec282a4812b8d2e12af28d75395af286030.summary: Test assertion in `free-agents.test.ts` updated to check all mission prompt variants in `shared/mission-prompt.ts` for the canonical opening line, replacing the previous check on `services/mission.ts`. This ensures any new candidate prompt added for evaluation maintains the required opening to prevent 403 errors on Auto mode. Scope limited to test suite; no shipped code changes.

6f2db456ac3170ab87b7099c362f20f295369fb3.title: Terminal watchdog test suite restructured with platform-specific
6f2db456ac3170ab87b7099c362f20f295369fb3.summary: Refactored terminal-watchdog.test.ts to spawn all fixtures in a single beforeAll hook with shared platform-aware timeouts (60s Windows, 15s Unix for ready state) instead of per-test spawns. Fixture arm deadline extended to 40s to prevent false negatives on slow runners. Diagnostics now include exact marker paths and timing budgets in error output.

4e2403d6d910b7b0f6566d1eba3bfb35d4fb0aaa.title: Tests switch-to-Flash nudge visibility
4e2403d6d910b7b0f6566d1eba3bfb35d4fb0aaa.summary: Added test case to `freebuff-model-selector.test.tsx` verifying the 'DeepSeek V4 Flash is now better' nudge appears only on the currently selected superseded model row. Ensures the 'NEW' badge renders for superseded models and that the nudge count remains exactly one when multiple superseded models are visible. Confirms no nudge appears when the recommended replacement model is selected.
